body.zh: 9/29：汤本富士屋酒店，双床房含早餐。9/30—10/4：BAY HOTEL东京滨松町，连续四晚。10/4：东横INN成田机场本馆。羽田T1 First Cabin是夜航后额外的六小时补觉。费用与购物明细集中在最后的双人账本。
body.en: 29 Sep: Yumoto Fujiya Hotel, twin room with breakfast. 30 Sep–4 Oct: four nights at BAY HOTEL Tokyo Hamamatsucho. 4 Oct: Toyoko Inn Narita Airport Honkan. First Cabin at Haneda T1 was an extra six-hour rest after the red-eye. Charges and shopping details are collected in the final shared ledger.

title.zh: 9月28日｜出发前奏：洗去班味，奔赴夜航
title.en: Departure prelude: wash away work, head for the night flight

subtitle.zh: 极乐汤川沙店 → 浦东T2

paragraphs.zh: 出发前的一天总带着点偷得浮生半日闲的惬意。上午收收尾，午后在家笃定地打包行李，小土则在一板一眼的周一工位上盼着下班。
paragraphs.en: The day before departure always has a little of that stolen-half-day feeling. I wrapped up some work in the morning and calmly packed at home in the afternoon, while Xiaotu waited for the end of an ordinary Monday at his desk.

paragraphs.zh: 上午：稍微上了一会儿班；小土正常工作日，早晨 8 点多出门上班。
paragraphs.en: Morning: I worked briefly; Xiaotu left for an ordinary workday after eight.

paragraphs.zh: 中午 ~ 下午：我中午午睡休息到 1 点多，起床开始收拾整理家里。
paragraphs.en: Midday and afternoon: I napped until after one, then tidied the house and packed.

paragraphs.zh: 16:00 许：收拾妥当，拖上行李正式迈出门。
paragraphs.en: Around 16:00: everything was ready, and I headed out with the suitcase.

paragraphs.zh: 18:30 许：抵达极乐汤（川沙店）。店面设施略有年代感，但作为出发前的泡汤选择非常合适且经济实惠
paragraphs.en: Around 18:30: I reached Gokurakuyu in Chuansha. The facilities felt dated, but it was a convenient, affordable stop before departure.

paragraphs.zh: 傍晚四点拖着行李箱出门，第一站选在离浦东机场不远的极乐汤川沙店。汤馆虽然看得出岁月的痕迹，但热水漫过肩颈的那一刻，连日工作的紧绷感瞬间消散。七点多小土风尘仆仆赶来汇合，热汤里泡热了身子，再趿着拖鞋在餐厅分食一份牛肉炒饭和一碗像极了方便面的拉面。食物说不上惊艳，但这种出发前热气腾腾的烟火气，却让人无比踏实。
paragraphs.en: At four I wheeled my suitcase out of the door. Our first stop was Gokurakuyu in Chuansha, not far from Pudong Airport. The bathhouse showed its age, but the moment hot water reached our shoulders, days of work tension began to dissolve. Xiaotu hurried over after seven; once we had warmed ourselves in the baths, we shuffled into the restaurant in slippers to share beef fried rice and a bowl of ramen that tasted rather like instant noodles. The food was hardly outstanding, yet this warm, everyday bustle before departure made us feel wonderfully settled.

paragraphs.zh: 19:00 多：小土下班赶来汇合，我们一起泡汤，洗去一身疲惫。
paragraphs.en: After 19:00: Xiaotu came from work and we soaked together, washing away the tiredness.

paragraphs.zh: 20:00 许：在汤泉馆内用晚餐：小土点了一份日式牛肉炒饭，我点了一碗牛肉拉面。拉面口感偏像方便面，我们整体感觉性价比一般。饭后休息喝了一杯奶茶。
paragraphs.en: Around 20:00: Xiaotu had beef fried rice and I had beef ramen. The noodles felt like instant noodles and the value was mediocre; afterward we rested with milk tea.

paragraphs.zh: 22:00 许：再次冲澡沐浴，清爽整装。
paragraphs.en: Around 22:00: another shower, ready to leave.

paragraphs.zh: 23:00 许：从极乐汤打车前往上海浦东国际机场 T2。
paragraphs.en: Around 23:00: a taxi from the bathhouse to Shanghai Pudong Airport T2.

paragraphs.zh: 深夜十一点打车穿越清冷的夜色直奔浦东机场，在 69 号贵宾室坐下静候登机。凌晨一点二十分，踏入机舱，红眼航班载着疲惫与雀跃，带我们飞向清晨的东京。
paragraphs.en: At eleven we took a taxi through the cool, quiet night to Pudong Airport, and sat in Lounge 69 waiting to board. At twenty past one we entered the cabin. Our red-eye carried both tiredness and excitement toward a morning in Tokyo.

title.zh: 9月29日｜羽田小憩与雨中箱根：辗转抵埗，亦是风味
title.en: A Haneda rest and rainy Hakone: transfers have their own flavour

subtitle.zh: 浦东T2 → 羽田T3

paragraphs.zh: 00:00 ~ 01:20：抵达上海浦东 T2，使用农行白金卡权益在 69 号 VIP 室休息候机、调整状态。
paragraphs.en: 00:00–01:20: we waited and rested in Lounge 69 at Pudong T2, using the Agricultural Bank platinum-card benefit.

paragraphs.zh: 01:20 左右：在 69 号 VIP 室待到 1:20 左右，收拾随身行李，动身出发前往登机口准备登机。
paragraphs.en: Around 01:20: we collected our hand luggage and left the lounge for boarding.

paragraphs.zh: 01:41：登机结束，舱门关闭，满怀期待等待起飞，旅途正式拉开序幕。
paragraphs.en: 01:41: boarding was complete and the doors closed. The journey had begun.

paragraphs.zh: 01:50：搭乘全日空 NH968 起飞（执飞机型为波音 787 客机，座位 30B）。机上屏幕显示着日式和风满月屏保。整段飞行非常迅速平稳，实际空中飞行时间仅 2 小时 12 分钟。
paragraphs.en: 01:50: NH968 departed on a Boeing 787; I sat in 30B. Its screen showed a Japanese-style full moon. The flight was smooth and quick, with two hours and twelve minutes in the air.

paragraphs.zh: 05:22：航班比原定时间大幅提前，平稳降落东京羽田国际机场 T3。停机坪带着清晨微润的气息，窗外静静停靠着刚刚载着我们跨海而来的 ANA 梦幻客机。
paragraphs.en: 05:22: we landed early at Haneda T3, before the scheduled 05:45. The morning apron felt faintly damp.

paragraphs.zh: 05:58：通关高效，顺利通过入境审查，在行李转盘处等候提取行李。
paragraphs.en: 05:58: immigration was finished, and we waited at baggage claim.

paragraphs.zh: 06:10 左右：提取完行李后，搭乘机场免费航站楼穿梭巴士从 T3 前往 T1 航站楼。
paragraphs.en: Around 06:10: after collecting our cases, the free terminal shuttle took us from T3 to T1.

title.en: Six quiet hours at Haneda

subtitle.zh: First Cabin · 羽田T1

paragraphs.zh: 红眼航班落地后的六个小时，是旅途最温柔的缓冲带。
paragraphs.en: The six hours after our red-eye landed were the gentlest buffer of the whole journey.

paragraphs.zh: 06:50 左右：顺利入住位于 T1 的 First Cabin 胶囊旅馆（羽田ターミナル1）。因为红眼航班通宵飞行十分消耗体力，果断选择在这里开钟点房休息 6 个小时（约 06:50 ~ 12:50）。
paragraphs.en: Around 06:50: we checked into First Cabin at Haneda T1 for six hours, approximately 06:50–12:50, to recover from the sleepless flight.

paragraphs.zh: 走进极具科技感的胶囊走廊，入住单人舱位，房间紧凑但干净舒适，床品整洁，终于能安稳躺平补觉，彻底洗去旅途疲劳。
paragraphs.en: The futuristic corridor led to compact but clean individual cabins with fresh bedding. At last we could lie flat and recover.

paragraphs.zh: 12:00：在胶囊房里一觉酣畅睡到正午 12 点，整个人元气大满。醒来时被自己的闹钟声惊了一下，下意识赶紧关掉，生怕吵到周围的日本客人，让人不禁莞尔于身处日本时不由自主的轻手轻脚与客气。
paragraphs.en: 12:00: I slept until noon, then hurriedly silenced my alarm, afraid of disturbing the nearby guests. I smiled at how naturally I became quiet and careful in Japan.

paragraphs.zh: 12:00 ~ 12:30：起床前往浴室洗了个热水澡。浴室整洁干净到令人发指，地板与设施一尘不染。虽然馆内的大浴场从早上 10 点开始进行例行清扫未能泡上，但单人淋浴间已足够让人彻底放松唤醒。
paragraphs.en: 12:00–12:30: a hot shower in an exceptionally clean bathroom. The communal bath had been closed for cleaning since ten, but the shower was enough to wake and relax me.

paragraphs.zh: 12:30：整理好行装顺利办理退房。准备在航站楼附近找点吃的填饱肚子，随后正式启程前往箱根。查阅天气预报发现东京和箱根未来几天都有雨水，心里不免带上了一丝忐忑，但也期待雨中箱根温泉的别样风情。
paragraphs.en: 12:30: packed and checked out, planning lunch before Hakone. The forecast promised rain in both Tokyo and Hakone, which made me a little uneasy but curious about hot springs in wet weather.

paragraphs.zh: 在 First Cabin 的静谧客舱里沉沉睡醒，冲去困意，转头便在机场吃了一碗热腾腾的札幌拉面。带着黄油香气与玉米的甜润，拉着行李箱一头扎进了通往神奈川的电车。
paragraphs.en: We slept deeply in First Cabin's quiet little cabins, washed away the grogginess, then found steaming Sapporo ramen in the airport. With butter fragrance and sweet corn still lingering, we pulled our suitcases onto the trains bound for Kanagawa.

title.en: Butter, miso and a perforated spoon

subtitle.zh: 札幌ラーメン 雪あかり · 羽田T1

paragraphs.zh: 12:40 ~ 13:30：在羽田机场 T1 品尝日式拉面午餐——「札幌ラーメン 雪あかり（羽田空港店）」。我们点了招牌味噌黄油玉米拉面、特制蘸面加蛋和肉煎饺。初次吃札幌拉面，黄油配浓郁味噌汤底很香，玉米粒很多，还附赠了专门捞玉米的带孔金属漏勺，细节贴心；口感略微偏咸，我们给出三星半（3.5星）评价。
paragraphs.en: 12:40–13:30: at Yukiakari we chose miso-butter-corn ramen, dipping noodles with egg and meat gyoza. My first Sapporo ramen was fragrant, with generous corn and a special perforated metal spoon to retrieve it. It was slightly salty: three and a half stars.

title.en: A red train and a rain-swollen river

subtitle.zh: 羽田 → 横滨 → 小田原 → 箱根汤本

paragraphs.zh: 13:30 ~ 15:50：一路辗转乘车（全程刷西瓜卡 Suica）：京急线（羽田T1·2 -> 横滨）、JR 东海道线（横滨 -> 小田原）、箱根登山电车（小田原 -> 箱根汤本）。换乘与路上折腾了两个多小时，约 15:50 抵达小田原换乘。在小田原站我们一度纠结是否购买箱根周游券，但看到窗外大雨倾盆，户外索道与海盗船游览受限，决定暂不购买，留待明日根据天气灵活安排。14:08：在羽田机场 7-11 买了一杯现磨咖啡。
paragraphs.en: 13:30–15:50: Suica took us through Keikyu to Yokohama, JR Tokaido to Odawara and the mountain train to Hakone-Yumoto. In the heavy rain at Odawara, we postponed the Freepass and left the ropeway and pirate ship dependent on tomorrow's weather. The note also records a 14:08 airport 7-Eleven coffee.

paragraphs.zh: 在小田原站换乘时，窗外已是暴雨倾盆。原本计划的周游券和观光缆车在雨幕中暂时搁浅，心里本有些许遗憾，可当鲜红色的登山电车穿过重重雨雾驶入箱根汤本，出站抬头看见柯南的联动看板，心中的阴霾竟被一扫而空。
paragraphs.en: At our Odawara transfer, torrential rain filled the view outside. The travel pass and sightseeing cable car we had planned were temporarily put on hold. I felt a little disappointed, but as the bright red mountain train carried us through layers of rain and mist into Hakone-Yumoto, and I looked up at the Conan collaboration sign on leaving the station, that gloom suddenly cleared.

paragraphs.zh: 16:00 许：电车抵达箱根汤本站。刚出站台，便看到了醒目的「ようこそ 箱根へ」紫阳花富士山迎宾看板，以及刚刚进站的鲜红色箱根登山电车。出站口悬挂着《名侦探柯南》第 108 卷联动看板，满满的日漫巡礼感。
paragraphs.en: Around 16:00: arriving at Hakone-Yumoto brought a hydrangea-and-Fuji welcome sign, a bright red train and the Detective Conan volume 108 collaboration display.

paragraphs.zh: 走出车站，虽然细雨蒙蒙，但雨中的箱根汤本别有一番空灵风韵：汤本站标志性的连续白色拱形雨棚在湿润的柏油路上映出倒影，两侧青山苍翠欲滴，云雾缭绕。
paragraphs.en: Outside, the white arched station canopy reflected on wet asphalt, with green mountains wrapped in cloud.

paragraphs.zh: 雨天的箱根，有着晴日无法比拟的空灵质感。汤本站拱形的雨棚在微湿的地面倒映出暖光，早川河水在脚下奔涌咆哮，卷着山林泥土与草木的清冷潮气。掩映在墨绿古树深处的富士屋酒店，像是一座静候旅人的深山隐所。
paragraphs.en: Rainy Hakone had an ethereal texture unlike any sunny day. The station's arched canopy reflected a warm glow on the damp ground; the Hayakawa roared below our feet, carrying the cool, earthy scent of forest and soil. Fujiya Hotel, tucked behind deep-green old trees, seemed like a secluded mountain retreat patiently waiting for travellers.

paragraphs.zh: 步行前往汤本富士屋酒店途中，脚下早川河水因大雨而激荡奔流、水势磅礴；主楼掩映在一片郁郁葱葱的参天古树之后，山径林荫道被雨水洗刷得幽静青碧。顺利办理入住本馆客房。
paragraphs.en: On the walk to Yumoto Fujiya Hotel, rain-swollen Hayakawa water surged beneath us. Old trees hid the hotel, and the washed-clean forest path was quiet and green.

paragraphs.zh: 16:30：倚窗俯瞰山道与雾气弥漫的远山，奔波大半天终于抵埗，身心彻底放松，真切体会到了“雨中箱根”独有的清幽与诗意。
paragraphs.en: 16:30: looking from the room over the road and misty hills, the whole day's travelling finally gave way to relaxation and the poetry of rainy Hakone.

title.en: Rainy barbecue, a hot outdoor bath

subtitle.zh: 烧肉スエヒロ → 湯処「早雲」

paragraphs.zh: 夜幕初降，温泉街的小店纷纷打烊，山里的雨意更浓了些。就近找了家烧肉店，围着热气腾腾的火炉，抿一口上升太阳 IPA 啤酒，碳水与油脂在嘴里化开，倒也驱散了漫漫寒意。饭后穿上浴衣与羽织，一头扎进「早雲」的露天风吕。微凉的雨丝落在头上，滚烫的泉水裹着周身，极具仪式感与冰火交融的畅快。泡完汤，倚在休息区的躺椅上咕嘟咕嘟灌下一整瓶蓝盖的明治冰咖啡牛奶，那一刻，所有的奔波与疲惫都烟消云散。
paragraphs.en: As dusk fell, the little shops along the hot-spring street closed one after another, and the mountain rain grew more insistent. We found a nearby barbecue restaurant, gathered around its hot grill and sipped Rising Sun IPA; warmth, carbs and fat drove away the chill. After dinner we put on yukata and haori and headed straight into Soun's open-air bath. Cool raindrops touched our heads while hot spring water wrapped our bodies: a ritual, and a wonderfully vivid meeting of hot and cold. Afterward, reclining in the lounge, I drank an entire blue-capped bottle of ice-cold Meiji coffee milk. In that moment, all the day's travelling and tiredness vanished.

paragraphs.zh: 18:30 ~ 19:30：在客房休整到傍晚六点半出门觅食。发现箱根温泉街店铺打烊很早，加之山中阴雨湿冷，就近选了离车站步行 3 分钟的「箱根湯本 焼肉スエヒロ（Suehiro）」吃烤肉暖身。点了和牛烤肉拼盘配本地精酿啤酒（Rising Sun IPA），味道中规中矩，给出 2.5 星评价。餐后踏着清凉雨夜散步回酒店。
paragraphs.en: 18:30–19:30: many hot-spring-street shops had closed, so we chose nearby Suehiro. A wagyu platter and Rising Sun IPA warmed us, though the flavour was only ordinary: two and a half stars. We walked back through the cool rain.

paragraphs.zh: 20:00 ~ 21:00：在客房休息到晚间八点，换上酒店准备的淡紫碎花日式浴衣与深色羽织外套，前往富士屋温泉湯処「早雲」大浴场泡汤，仪式感满满。室内设高温池与绵密气泡池；室外设有带顶棚与完全无顶的露天风吕。在微凉秋雨中浸入滚烫露天汤泉，雨丝拂面，身下温润，极其舒畅惬意。随后体验低温桑拿，全身排汗彻底放松。
paragraphs.en: 20:00–21:00: we put on lilac floral yukata and dark haori for Soun. Indoor hot and bubbling pools, covered and uncovered outdoor baths, cool rain on the face and hot water around the body made it wonderfully soothing. A low-temperature sauna finished the relaxation.

paragraphs.zh: 21:05 许：泡完温泉出来神清气爽，在休息区我们各刷西瓜卡买了一瓶经典的「meiji 明治 宅配のコーヒー」（蓝盖瓶装咖啡牛奶），倚在暖色躺椅上放空慢饮。虽然首日因雨缆车受阻略有遗憾，但这雨夜热汤、冰牛奶与静谧山景，让整天过得无比充实愉悦。
paragraphs.en: Around 21:05: we each bought blue-capped Meiji coffee milk with Suica and reclined in the lounge. Despite missing the cable car, the rainy bath, cold milk and quiet mountains made the day feel full.

paragraphs.zh: 夜间花絮（小土偷喝牛奶事件）：深夜客房就寝前，小土悄悄跑去自动售货机买了一瓶牛奶偷喝，成为旅途中的小插曲。
paragraphs.en: Late-night aside: Xiaotu quietly went back to the vending machine for another bottle of milk—the secret milk incident.

paragraphs.zh: 辗转奔波了一整天，当终于在客房卸下行囊、听着山峦间沙沙雨声的那一刻，忽然懂得——旅行并不只有晴空万里才算圆满，雨幕、急流与漫山翠色，何尝不是另一种意料之外的温润滋味。
paragraphs.en: After a whole day of moving from place to place, we finally put down our bags in the room and listened to rain whispering through the mountains. Suddenly I understood that a journey does not need endless blue skies to feel complete. Rain curtains, rushing water and green hills can offer their own unexpected, gentle flavour.

title.zh: 9月30日｜从山林到都心：雨中跳车、热咖喱与十平米的安宁
title.en: From hills to city: a rainy detour, hot curry and a compact refuge

subtitle.zh: 汤本富士屋酒店

paragraphs.zh: 08:30：昨夜伴着雨声在 00:30 入睡，整整踏实睡满了 7 个多小时的高质量好觉，醒来神清气爽，整个人疲惫全消。
paragraphs.en: 08:30: after going to bed at 00:30 to the sound of rain, we woke refreshed from more than seven good hours.

paragraphs.zh: 08:45 ~ 09:15：简单洗漱后前往餐厅享用丰盛的日式自助早餐（已包含在房费中，无需额外自费）。虽非传统的“一泊二食”会席，但自助料理品类极为丰富：热腾腾的爽滑乌冬面、自选丰富配料的小料味噌汤，以及拌了经典日式和风沙拉汁的清脆蔬菜沙拉，格外爽口开胃。
paragraphs.en: 08:45–09:15: breakfast was included. It was not traditional kaiseki, but the buffet was plentiful, with hot udon, miso soup with chosen toppings and crisp vegetables in Japanese dressing.

paragraphs.zh: 09:15 ~ 09:30：回客房稍作休息消食。
paragraphs.en: 09:15–09:30: a short rest in the room.

paragraphs.zh: 09:30 ~ 10:00：赶在上午 10:00 大浴场清扫关门前，冲进温泉享受最后一波晨汤。晨光与薄雾中的池水格外清澈温暖，唤醒全身每一个细胞。
paragraphs.en: 09:30–10:00: one final bath before the ten o'clock cleaning closure. Morning light and thin mist made the water feel particularly clear and warm.

paragraphs.zh: 10:00：准时出浴。大浴场营业结束，我们再次迎来泡汤后的标配仪式感——在休息区美美喝冰牛奶，每人各喝一瓶（我喝咖啡味，小土喝原味）。喝完牛奶后穿着酒店浴袍在庭院与连廊拍照散步，留下美好的纪念。
paragraphs.en: 10:00: out of the bath, then our cold-milk ritual again—coffee for me, plain for Xiaotu. We walked and photographed the garden and corridors in the hotel robes.

caption.zh: 09.30 10:18 · 晨汤后的咖啡与原味牛奶
caption.en: 09.30 10:18 · Coffee and plain milk after the morning bath

paragraphs.zh: 10:30 ~ 11:00：回客房打包行李，完成最后的休整。
paragraphs.en: 10:30–11:00: back to the room to pack and finish resting.

paragraphs.zh: 11:00：前台正式办理退房（Check-out），在前台结清温泉税（入汤税）。
paragraphs.en: 11:00: checked out and settled the bathing tax at reception.

title.en: Warmth and autumn colours above the lake

subtitle.zh: 元箱根 / 成川美术馆

paragraphs.zh: 11:30 ~ 12:30：搭乘登山巴士翻越山路前往元箱根。
paragraphs.en: 11:30–12:30: the mountain bus took us over the hills to Moto-Hakone.

paragraphs.zh: 乌龙事件（下车西瓜卡余额不足被扣押事件）：12:30 抵达元箱根下车刷卡时，发现 Suica 余额不足扣款失败。司机态度颇急躁，将人“扣”在车上不断大声催促逼逼，站在前门手忙脚乱赶紧用手机充值，被疯狂催促了一通，好不容易充好刷卡成功才得以脱身下车，既狼狈又好笑。
paragraphs.en: At about 12:30 my Suica balance failed on leaving the bus. The impatient driver kept urging me on while I fumbled a phone top-up at the front door. Finally the payment went through: awkward and funny.

paragraphs.zh: 趣闻插曲（美术馆楼下小情侣吵架事件）：下车后山风夹着冷雨格外阴冷刺骨，我们快步走向成川美术馆。在入馆楼下偶遇一对年轻男生情侣闹别扭拌嘴，小受委屈控诉“我好生气”，另一人则连环追问“你为什么要生这么大的气？为什么要生这么大的气？”，一旁的小土八卦之魂熊熊燃烧、特别想上前问个究竟，我们约定等逛完下来如果还在就去问问，可惜出来时人家早已离开。
paragraphs.en: Cold wind and rain sent us toward Narukawa. Downstairs two young men were having a lovers' quarrel: 'I'm so angry,' said one; the other kept asking, 'Why are you so angry?' Xiaotu badly wanted to know. We agreed to ask if they remained afterward, but they had gone.

caption.zh: 09.30 12:12 · 芦之湖 · 箱根神社鸟居

paragraphs.zh: 12:30 ~ 13:00 成川美术馆避寒与秋日展：赶紧钻进温暖的成川美术馆（Narukawa Art Museum）避风取暖。美术馆依山傍水、小巧精致，展品虽不算繁多但格外耐看。馆内正逢秋季馆藏名作特展「日本画の煌めき 秋の彩り」（日本画的光芒·秋之色彩），其中最引人瞩目的大作正是现代日本画名家木村圭吾所绘的屏风大作，浓墨重彩地生动再现了箱根仙石原芒草草原迎风起伏的金黄秋景；同展还有前本利彦的「咲き乱れる夢幻の花」等花鸟佳作，在微冷雨日里静静观画，意境极美。拍了许多照片，一直逛到下午 1 点左右尽兴离开。
paragraphs.en: 12:30–13:00: Narukawa was small, warm and beautifully situated above the water. The autumn collection exhibition '日本画の煌めき 秋の彩り' included Keigo Kimura's vivid golden Sengokuhara pampas-grass screen and Toshihiko Maemoto's dreamlike flowers. We photographed and looked quietly until around one.

caption.zh: 09.30 12:23 · 成川美术馆 · 日本画
09.30 12:24 · 成川美术馆 · 日本画
09.30 12:34 · 成川美术馆的芦之湖窗景

title.en: BACKGROUND

body.zh: 成川美术馆1988年开馆，收藏核心是现代日本画。这里的秋展名称与作品描述保留原笔记，基础沿革可参照馆方：http://www.narukawamuseum.co.jp/en/about/index.html
body.en: Narukawa opened in 1988 and focuses on modern Nihonga. Exhibition and work descriptions retain the source note; museum history: http://www.narukawamuseum.co.jp/en/about/index.html

title.en: The rain stopped on the shrine path

subtitle.zh: 箱根神社 / 九头龙神社新宫

paragraphs.zh: 13:10 ~ 14:00：从成川美术馆出来，我们在绵绵细雨中沿芦之湖畔幽静栈道漫步前往箱根神社。一路雨丝飘拂，然而刚踏入箱根神社的参道巨木参天之处，天空的细雨竟神奇地戛然而止、雨过天晴，仿佛神明眷顾的天意般令人惊叹。
paragraphs.en: 13:10–14:00: fine rain followed us along the lakeside, but stopped as soon as we entered the giant-tree avenue at Hakone Shrine. The coincidence felt like a blessing.

paragraphs.zh: 迎请两份「御神印」：分别授受了箱根神社与九头龙神社的两份手写印记。特别有意思的是，这里不称寺院流传的“御朱印”，而特称「御神印（ごしんいん）」，寓意受领神明护佑之印，格外庄严雅致。
paragraphs.en: We received handwritten goshin-in stamps from Hakone Shrine and Kuzuryu Shrine Shingu. The distinctive name, rather than goshuin, felt solemn and graceful.

paragraphs.zh: 在参道古杉林间一直游览漫步到下午 2:00，祈福参拜完后身心通透，尽兴离开。
paragraphs.en: We wandered among the old cedars until two, then left feeling clear and satisfied.

caption.zh: 09.30 13:44 · 社殿与九头龙新宫的水
caption.en: 09.30 13:44 · Shrine buildings and Kuzuryu Shingu water

caption.zh: 09.30 13:51 · 社殿与九头龙新宫的水
caption.en: 09.30 13:51 · Shrine buildings and Kuzuryu Shingu water

title.en: SHRINE NOTES FROM THE SOURCE

body.zh:
• 箱根神社：公元 757 年高僧万卷上人开山，主祭神「箱根大神」，自源赖朝、德川家康以来为关东地位最高的总镇守，主管心愿成就、开运除厄与交通安全。
• 九头龙神社：源自万卷上人以高深佛法调伏芦之湖九头毒龙、化害为利成为水神守护湖泊的传说。新宫特设于箱根神社境内，是全日本极负盛名的良缘结缘与金运招福能量圣地。
• 为什么叫「御神印」：古老神道名社为恪守神圣威仪，不随寺院称“御朱印”，而特称“御神印（ごしんいん）”，意为“奉受神明之尊印”，更显庄重。
九头龙故事按传说阅读；本次到访的是箱根神社境内新宫。御神印称谓保留为这里的具体记忆，不推广为所有神社统一用语。https://hakonejinja.or.jp/
body.en: The source dates Hakone Shrine's founding to 757 by Mangan, names Hakone Okami and notes its links to Yoritomo and Ieyasu and prayers for luck, protection and safe travel. It relates the legend of Mangan subduing Lake Ashi's nine-headed dragon, later honoured as a protective water deity. It also records the local term goshin-in for the shrine stamps. The dragon story is a legend; we visited the Shingu in Hakone Shrine's grounds, not the separate main shrine. The terminology is a local memory, not a universal rule. https://hakonejinja.or.jp/

title.zh: 雨中跳车，再去一座美术馆
title.en: Off the bus, toward one more museum

subtitle.zh: 元箱根 → 小涌谷 → 雕刻之森

paragraphs.zh: 旅行中最妙的时刻，往往发生在“计划被打破”的瞬间。
paragraphs.en: The best moments of travel often happen just when a plan breaks apart.

paragraphs.zh: 清晨在富士屋的晨汤里洗去残存的倦意，喝完冰牛奶退房，本以为阴雨会让箱根之行草草收尾。可当大巴开到半途，一眼瞥见山林里穿梭的红色铁轨，我们竟默契地在小涌谷“跳了车”。大雾大雨漫山遍野，冲进雕刻之森，在散落群山的现代雕塑与毕加索的陶艺真迹间游荡整整一小时。原来不看晴空下的富士山，也丝毫不妨碍雨中的箱根美得惊心动魄。
paragraphs.en: A morning bath at Fujiya washed away the last of our tiredness. We drank cold milk and checked out, assuming the wet weather would bring Hakone to an early close. But halfway along the bus route, a glimpse of red railway tracks threading the forest prompted us both to 'jump off' at Kowakidani. Rain and mist covered the mountains as we hurried into the Open-Air Museum and wandered for a full hour among modern sculpture and Picasso's original ceramics. It turned out that not seeing Fuji under blue skies did nothing to prevent rainy Hakone from being breathtaking.

paragraphs.zh: 14:15 ~ 14:45：从元箱根搭乘返程公交车，车行至半途，看到窗外在浓密山林间穿梭的箱根登山铁道，我们心中突然闪过一个念头——既然都到了这里，为什么不去赫赫有名的「雕刻之森美术馆」看看呢？没有过多犹疑，我们果断按下下车铃，在小涌谷站提前下车！
paragraphs.en: 14:15–14:45: heading back by bus, we spotted the mountain railway in the trees and thought: since we were here, why not visit the Open-Air Museum? We rang the bell and got off early at Kowakidani.

paragraphs.zh: 14:58：在弥漫着山雾的小涌谷站台，顺利坐上了开往强罗方向的箱根登山电车，奔赴雕刻之森。窗外的山雨与浓雾变得格外浩大，群山隐没在茫茫白雾中。临时推翻了刚才“结束箱根行程”的决定，怀着一种“不知道冒大雨去会不会后悔呢”的忐忑与雀跃，随性开启属于我们的箱根雨中冒险续集。
paragraphs.en: 14:58: on a misty platform we boarded toward Gora. Rain and fog grew heavier, and the 'finished Hakone' plan became an uncertain but exciting rainy encore.

caption.zh: 09.30 14:57 · 小涌谷的箱根登山电车

paragraphs.zh: 15:10：电车抵达雕刻之森站，入馆「雕刻之森美术馆（The Hakone Open-Air Museum / 彫刻の森美術館）」。入馆前在 Klook 上用微信订票。
paragraphs.en: 15:10: we reached Chokoku-no-Mori and entered the Hakone Open-Air Museum after booking through Klook.

title.en: Sculpture and clay among the hills

subtitle.zh: 雕刻之森美术馆 / 毕加索馆

paragraphs.zh: 艺术漫游（15:10 ~ 16:10）：作为日本首座野外美术馆（1969年开馆），7万平方米的群山绿地之间错落伫立着罗丹、亨利·摩尔等世界级大师的百余件巨型现代雕塑，即使在烟雨大雾中也散发着极具张力的自然与艺术交融之美。
paragraphs.en: 15:10–16:10: opened in 1969 as Japan's first open-air art museum, it places large modern sculptures among mountain greenery. Rain and fog heightened the tension between art and nature.

caption.zh: 09.30 15:24 · 雕刻之森的草地与溪流
09.30 15:25 · 雕刻之森的草地与溪流

caption.en: 09.30 15:20 · Rainy portrait at the Open-Air Museum

title.en: INTO THE INDOOR COLLECTION

body.zh: 雨里的草地和红伞之后，再看室内人物雕塑。它们与后面毕加索馆的陶艺分开，不混作同一位艺术家的作品。
body.en: After wet grass and red umbrellas, we turned to indoor figure sculpture. These are separate from the Picasso Pavilion's ceramics, not presented as one artist's work.

caption.en: 09.30 15:16 · Indoor sculpture at the Open-Air Museum
09.30 15:16 · Indoor sculpture at the Open-Air Museum

paragraphs.zh: 毕加索馆巡礼：特别参观了馆内的标志性专属「毕加索馆（Picasso Pavilion）」，这里系统展出了大师晚期独具魅力的陶艺、版画与珍贵油画真迹（收藏量达300余件），艺术冲击力十足。我们在山谷与艺术品间细细漫步穿行，整整逛满了一小时，大呼有趣值回票价。
paragraphs.en: The Picasso Pavilion gave us ceramics, prints and original paintings, with the note recording a collection of over three hundred works. We spent a full hour moving between the valley and the artworks and felt it was fascinating and worthwhile.

title.en: BACKGROUND

body.zh: 雕刻之森1969年开馆，让有起伏的草地、溪流和山景也参与观看。https://www.hakone-oam.or.jp/en/about/
body.en: Opened in 1969, the museum makes contours, grass, streams and mountain views part of looking at sculpture. https://www.hakone-oam.or.jp/en/about/

title.zh: 之字形下山，一盘热咖喱
title.en: Zigzag downhill, then hot curry

subtitle.zh: 箱根汤本 → 小田原 → 大崎

paragraphs.zh: 乘着古老的登山列车在之字形铁轨上反复折返下山，带着一兜箱根伴手礼与行李，一头扎进直奔东京的湘南新宿线。出站时夜风冷得人打寒颤，我们在大崎的优衣库买了救命的厚毛衣，钻进街角香气腾腾的小店，分食了一盘炸得金黄酥脆的炸猪排咖喱。热气涌上来的瞬间，疲惫被彻底熨帖。
paragraphs.en: The old mountain train reversed again and again along its zigzag tracks as we descended. With Hakone souvenirs and our luggage, we headed onto the Shonan-Shinjuku Line toward Tokyo. The night wind outside Osaki made us shiver, so Uniqlo supplied a life-saving warm sweater before we ducked into a fragrant little curry shop. A plate of golden, crisp pork-cutlet curry sent up steam, and our tiredness was gently pressed flat.

paragraphs.zh: 16:25 ~ 17:07：从雕刻之森站搭乘箱根登山电车下山，慢悠悠开了 40 多分钟，于 17:07 抵达箱根汤本站。
paragraphs.en: 16:25–17:07: the mountain train took over forty minutes downhill to Hakone-Yumoto.

caption.zh: 09.30 17:08 · 下山铁轨 / 箱根汤本站
09.30 17:08 · 下山铁轨 / 箱根汤本站

title.en: RAILWAY NOTES · FROM THE SOURCE

body.zh:
箱根登山电车是全日本坡度最险峻的普通铁道（最大坡度达惊人的 80‰，每前进 1,000 米落差 80 米）。因山势过于陡峭无法直线爬坡，全线设立了 3 处折返点（出山信号所、大平台站等）。列车开入尽头盲轨停稳后，司机与列车长会走下车互换驾驶舱，原本的车尾瞬间变为车头，列车逆向驶出，呈“之”字形在山体峭壁间层层盘旋下行；转弯处车轮还会向轨道自动喷水降噪降磨，极富复古工业美感。
折返示意与线路信息：https://www.hakonenavi.jp/international/en/transportation/hakone-tozan
body.en: The source records an 80‰ maximum gradient, an 80-metre height change over 1,000 metres, and three switchback locations including Deyama and Ohiradai. After stopping at a dead end, driver and conductor exchange cabs, the old rear becomes the front, and the train reverses to zigzag through the hillside. Water is sprayed on curves to reduce wear and noise. Railway information: https://www.hakonenavi.jp/international/en/transportation/hakone-tozan

paragraphs.zh: 17:07 ~ 17:35：出站后在箱根汤本站前热闹的伴手礼街逛了逛，挑选采购了一些箱根特色的伴手礼留念。随后步行回汤本富士屋酒店取回寄存的大件行李。
paragraphs.en: 17:07–17:35: we browsed the souvenir street, bought Hakone gifts and returned to Fujiya for our stored cases.

paragraphs.zh: 17:39：掐点坐上了 17:39 前往小田原站的电车。
paragraphs.en: 17:39: just in time for the train to Odawara.

paragraphs.zh: 18:00 许：在小田原站无缝换乘 JR 湘南新宿线（直通东京都心），开启约两小时的归途车程，直奔东京港区，准备入住今晚的「BAY HOTEL 东京滨松町」。
paragraphs.en: Around 18:00: at Odawara we changed onto the Shonan-Shinjuku Line toward central Tokyo and our Hamamatsucho base.

paragraphs.zh: 19:00：搭乘湘南新宿线历经近两小时车程，顺利抵达东京大崎站（语音记为“大旗”）。下车出站，东京夜色深沉，秋风吹来依然冷意十足。
paragraphs.en: Around 19:00 in the note: arriving at Osaki, we stepped into a dark, cold Tokyo evening.

paragraphs.zh: 优衣库添衣：在「ユニクロ JR大崎駅改札内店」购买了一件经典款的「可机洗米兰罗纹针织毛衣」（ウォッシャブルミラノリブセーター），保暖又有型。
paragraphs.en: A washable Milano-rib sweater from Uniqlo inside Osaki station supplied much-needed warmth.

paragraphs.zh: 咖喱晚餐：在站旁口碑小店「カレーハウス リオ 大崎（Curry House Rio Osaki）」就餐。我们分别点了菠菜炸猪排咖喱（Katsu curry with spinach）和蔬菜可乐饼日式咖喱（Japanese curry with vegetable croquette）。炸猪排金黄酥脆肉厚多汁，可乐饼软糯香甜，裹着浓郁热咖喱特别暖胃。店内环境安静舒适、十分好聊天，在 Google 评价中打出了 4 星好评（⭐⭐⭐⭐，口味4/服务4/氛围3）！
paragraphs.en: Curry House Rio served spinach pork-cutlet curry and vegetable-croquette curry. Crisp juicy pork, soft sweet croquettes and rich hot curry were wonderfully warming. The quiet room was easy to talk in; four stars for the visit.

title.en: A little over ten square metres of peace

subtitle.zh: BAY HOTEL · 滨松町

paragraphs.zh: 晚上八点半摸进滨松町的酒店。十来平米逼仄的房间里，两张一米窄床并排挨着，小土一边甩开鞋子一边吐槽“怎么跟如家似的”。可翻出去年高田马场昂贵的账单两相对比，在这座欲望与喧嚣并存的巨大都会里，能以如此踏实的价格在繁华港区拥有一处落脚遮风的避风港，谁又能说这不是一种难得的幸事呢？
paragraphs.en: At half past eight we finally found our way into the Hamamatsucho hotel. In a cramped room of a little over ten square metres, two metre-wide beds sat close together. Xiaotu kicked off his shoes and complained that it felt like a budget chain back home. Yet after comparing it with last year's expensive Takadanobaba booking, how could I call an affordable shelter in the heart of busy Minato anything but a small piece of good fortune in this enormous city of desire and noise?

paragraphs.zh: 20:00 许：搭乘山手线抵达滨松町（语音记为“冰松厅”）。从 JR 站出来步行不到 5 分钟即达，地理位置极其方便。途中路过罗森便利店买了些饮品小食。
paragraphs.en: Around 20:00: the Yamanote Line brought us to Hamamatsucho. The hotel was under five minutes from the station, with a Lawson stop on the way.

paragraphs.zh: 20:30：顺利抵达并办理入住「BAY HOTEL 东京滨松町」，开启连续 4 晚的东京据点生活。
paragraphs.en: 20:30: checked into BAY HOTEL for four consecutive nights.

paragraphs.zh: 客房与趣味对比：进房放下行李，小土开启了日常嫌弃吐槽模式，觉得房间只有 10 来个平米太小了，狭长的通道一侧并排挤着两张 1 米宽的单人床和小小的一体卫浴，直呼“有点像如家”。不过翻出去年国庆高田马场的订单一对比，我觉得性价比其实相当出色。虽紧凑但整洁温馨，卸下两日奔波的行囊，在东京的第一夜踏实安顿下来。
paragraphs.en: Xiaotu began his usual complaining: the room was only around ten square metres, with two metre-wide beds beside a narrow passage and small bathroom. 'A bit like a budget chain,' he said. Comparing it with last year's Takadanobaba order, I still thought the location and value were good. Small but clean, it let us settle after two days of travelling.

paragraphs.zh: 窄小的通道里堆着箱子，窗外是繁华东京的秋夜长鸣。两天的山林雨雾翻篇，明早拉开窗帘，东京的漫游才正要开场。
paragraphs.en: Suitcases crowded the narrow passage, while Tokyo's autumn night hummed beyond the window. Two days of mountain rain and mist had turned their final page. Tomorrow, opening the curtains would be the real beginning of our Tokyo wandering.

title.zh: 10月1日｜都心晴空：狂暴买买买、穿堂买路财与午夜罗森
title.en: A blue city sky: shopping, a shortcut toll and midnight Lawson

subtitle.zh: 滨松町 → 新宿

paragraphs.zh: 清晨拉开窗帘的那一刻，东京用毫无保留的晴空万里的蓝，治愈了前两天箱根漫天大雨的所有遗憾。半梦半醒间瞥见窗外大太阳，心里暗暗笑称：“今天去箱根的大概全都是天气之子吧，呜呜！”
paragraphs.en: The moment I opened the curtains, Tokyo's entirely unreserved blue sky seemed to heal every regret from our two rainy days in Hakone. Half awake, I looked at the brilliant sunshine and laughed to myself: 'Everyone going to Hakone today must be a child of the weather. Oh, come on!'

paragraphs.zh: 上午：连续两天山林风雨奔波后，今天在滨松町美美睡了个自然醒大懒觉。上午 9 点多半梦半醒之间，透过窗帘缝隙瞥见外面竟是一个艳阳高照的大晴天，心里美滋滋的（内心忍不住暗暗戏谑：“今天去箱根的大概全都是天气之子吧，呜呜！”）。
paragraphs.en: Morning: after two wet days in the hills, we slept naturally. Sunshine glimpsed after nine made me joke that today's Hakone visitors must be weather-blessed.

paragraphs.zh: 10:30 ~ 11:30：赖床到 10 点半才慢悠悠起来，在房间悠闲洗漱更衣、整理随身行装。
paragraphs.en: 10:30–11:30: slowly out of bed, washing and dressing at leisure.

paragraphs.zh: 11:30：迎着晴空准时迈出酒店大门，满怀好心情出发！今日计划先直奔繁华都会核心——新宿，转转顺便开启买买买购物模式！
paragraphs.en: 11:30: out into the sunshine, bound for Shinjuku and shopping.

paragraphs.zh: 十点半慢悠悠醒来，迎着艳阳直奔新宿。刚出站就遭遇了一出啼笑皆非的“买路财”乌龙——想穿过 NEWoMan 抄近道，同站进出竟被闸机结结实实扣了 160 日元的站台入场券。在花园神社参拜求受御朱印时，意外获赠了一包印着江户辣椒与生姜的和红茶，谐音双关的日式幽默让人莞尔。随后钻进寿司郎，在几乎零店员接触的全自动数字化轨道前大快朵颐。
paragraphs.en: We woke leisurely at half past ten and went straight to Shinjuku in the sunshine. Almost immediately came a ridiculous little toll: trying to cut through NEWoMan meant entering and leaving the same station, and the gates firmly charged us a JPY 160 platform admission fee. At Hanazono Shrine, receiving our stamp also brought an unexpected packet of Japanese black tea printed with Edo chilli and ginger—a small piece of Japanese wordplay that made us smile. Then we ducked into Sushiro and ate happily beside its almost entirely contact-free, digital ordering system.

paragraphs.zh: 12:10 花园神社（新宿总镇守）与红茶奇遇：
paragraphs.en: 12:10: Hanazono Shrine and an unexpected tea gift.

paragraphs.zh: 穿过繁华商业街抵达新宿五丁目的「花园神社（花園神社）」。
paragraphs.en: We crossed the busy streets to Hanazono Shrine in Shinjuku 5-chome.

title.zh: 花园神社 · 原笔记的资料页
title.en: HANAZONO · BACKGROUND FROM THE NOTE

body.zh:
尾张德川与花之名：早在德川家康建立幕府前便镇守于此，后因新宿开宿拓建，迁入尾张德川家下屋敷名花盛开的庭园中，故得名「花园」。历经数百年，不仅是保佑商贸开运的“新宿总镇守”，每年 11 月的“酉之市（酉の市）”更吸引数十万人祈求财运。
演艺界朝圣圣地 · 芸能浅间神社：境内摄社“芸能浅间神社”供奉木花之佐久夜毘売，自江户时代便是戏剧演艺起源地，至今仍是日本演艺明星、舞者、歌手与剧团祈求大红大紫的朝圣地，社旁赤红玉垣刻满了各大演艺名社与名角之名。
「花園ジンジャー」将神社Jinja与生姜Ginger作谐音双关，笔记记录茶包配有和红茶、生姜与内藤辣椒。赠品为本次所得，不保证下次仍有。https://hanazono-jinja.or.jp/
body.en: The note links the shrine's name to its move into the Owari Tokugawa family's flower garden, and describes its role as Shinjuku's guardian and the November Tori-no-Ichi festival. It identifies Geino Asama as a shrine of performing-arts prayers, with performers' names on the red fences. Hanazono Ginger plays on jinja and ginger; the note lists Japanese black tea, ginger and Naito chilli in the gift. This was our visit's gift, not a promised future benefit. https://hanazono-jinja.or.jp/

title.en: A self-service sushi lunch

subtitle.zh: 寿司郎 · 新宿

paragraphs.zh: 参拜后前往知名回转寿司连锁「寿司郎（スシロー）」品尝日本本土风味。
paragraphs.en: After the shrine we went to Sushiro for a Japanese conveyor-belt sushi lunch.

paragraphs.zh: 刚进店就被极度智能化的全自助流程惊艳：完全无需任何店员引导，在门口自助取号机触摸取号、等待大屏叫号，扫码自动领取印有座号的席位卡入座；从取水杯、倒茶到平板下单全部自主完成，充满科技感与社恐友好的极速体验，吃得又快又舒心。
paragraphs.en: The digital self-service process surprised us: take a number, watch the calling screen, scan for a seating slip, get cups and tea and order on the tablet. Almost no staff interaction was necessary; quick, comfortable and friendly to the socially shy.

title.en: MEAL NOTE

body.zh: 从取号到点餐都是自己完成，吃得又快又舒心。原笔记评价：四星。
body.en: From waiting number to orders, we did it ourselves and ate quickly and happily. The note's verdict: four stars.

title.zh: 狂暴买买买与一袋袋欢愉
title.en: Shopping bags and straightforward delight

subtitle.zh: 优衣库 / 丸井MEN / 伊势丹 / Alpen / 始祖鸟
subtitle.en: Uniqlo / Marui MEN / Isetan / Alpen / Arc'teryx

paragraphs.zh: 下午两点，新宿的都市旋风正式卷走理智。优衣库里一口气扫光十五件秋冬毛衣与打底裤，丸井男士馆里挑中心仪的开衫与风衣，伊势丹里为鞋柜添置皮鞋，再一头扎进 Alpen TOKYO 抱回尤尼克斯的专业羽拍与球鞋，最后在始祖鸟专柜拿下心心念念的黑蓝 Atom 神衣。退税柜台前一遍遍核对单据，退税通叮咚入账，满载的不仅是沉甸甸的纸袋，更是都市漫游最纯粹的踏实与欢愉。
paragraphs.en: At two in the afternoon, Shinjuku's urban whirlwind swept away our reason. Uniqlo supplied fifteen pieces of autumn and winter knitwear and base layers; Marui MEN yielded the cardigans and coats we liked; Isetan added shoes to the cupboard. At Alpen TOKYO we picked up professional Yonex badminton gear, and finally, at Arc'teryx, the black-blue Atom jacket I had been thinking about. We checked receipts again and again at the tax-refund counters, with notifications chiming as refunds arrived. Those heavy bags carried not only purchases, but the straightforward joy and satisfaction of wandering a city.

paragraphs.zh: 14:27 优衣库 新宿三丁目店：一口气扫货 15 件（超极暖/极暖羊绒打底裤、摇粒绒夹克、AIRism T恤、无缝内裤、袜子组等），柜台直接免税。
paragraphs.en: 14:27: Uniqlo supplied fifteen pieces, including thermal base layers, fleece, AIRism, underwear and socks, with tax exemption at the counter.

paragraphs.zh: 15:14 ~ 16:30 新宿丸井男士馆 (新宿マルイ MEN)：分别在 3F EXTEDLAB 购入华夫格开衫与复合尼龙裤，以及在 UNION STATION 购入休闲裤与夹克外套。随后在丸井退税柜台办理合并退税，税金原路直达微信零钱。
paragraphs.en: 15:14–16:30: at Marui MEN we bought EXTEDLAB's waffle cardigan and nylon trousers and UNION STATION trousers and a jacket. Combined refunds went back to WeChat.

title.zh: 衣料与剪裁 · 原笔记的品牌页
title.en: CLOTH AND CUT · THE SOURCE'S BRAND NOTES

body.zh:
EXTEDLAB (Produce by TÊTE HOMME / テットオム)：
深厚历史：母体品牌 TÊTE HOMME 于 1981 年由著名设计师加藤和孝在东京创立，已有 40 余年历史，是日本现代男装时尚（DC品牌潮）的先驱代表之一，深受日本资深艺人（如堺正章、馆博）推崇。
风格剪裁：主打“奔跑在时代前沿的男士风范”，将日式暗黑摩登（Mode）与高超的立体版型融合。EXTEDLAB 是其专为注重成熟剪裁、追求面料机能与年轻时尚感的都市男性设立的高端概念线，华夫格质感针织开衫与复合尼龙长裤兼具雅痞松弛与耐穿实穿性。
Collective UNION STATION (BIGI / 株式会社ビギ集团)：
殿堂母体：出自日本男装界教父级时尚巨头 BIGI 集团（传奇男装 MEN'S BIGI 的母公司）。
品牌灵魂：核心理念为「さりげない上品さ（不经意的高级感与优雅）」，主打 Clean British 与现代日式极简主义。以讲究的面料手感、利落修身的肩胸线条著称，百搭好穿，自带温润内敛的高级书卷气与都市绅士感。
body.en: The note identifies EXTEDLAB with TÊTE HOMME, founded in Tokyo by Kazutaka Kato in 1981, describing a combination of modern Japanese styling, dimensional cutting and practical fabrics. It connects Collective UNION STATION to the BIGI group and quotes its principle of 'unobtrusive refinement', with clean British influences, restrained Japanese styling, good fabric feel and neat shoulder-and-chest lines. These are the source's brand impressions and background, not new recommendations.

paragraphs.zh: 17:08 ~ 18:27 伊势丹新宿本店：在专柜凭贵宾卡 95 折购入一双精品男鞋。随后在 Global Blue 柜台办理退税，现场领回现金。
paragraphs.en: 17:08–18:27: at Isetan we bought men's shoes with the guest-card discount, then collected a cash Global Blue refund.

paragraphs.zh: 19:20 Alpen TOKYO：在大型运动集合店为羽毛球运动添置全套专业装备，包括 Yonex NF700P 羽毛球拍、SHB65Z4W 宽楦羽球鞋、手胶及 Oakley 护腕。
paragraphs.en: 19:20: Alpen TOKYO supplied a Yonex NF700P racket, SHB65Z4W wide-fit badminton shoes, grips and Oakley wristbands.

paragraphs.zh: 20:08 始祖鸟 新宿品牌店 (Arc'teryx)：成功入手鸟家经典连帽轻量棉服 Atom Hoody（深海黑蓝 Black Sapphire，L 码），专柜直接免税。
paragraphs.en: 20:08: an L-size Arc'teryx Atom Hoody in Black Sapphire completed the shopping.

title.en: After twenty thousand steps, a Lawson supper

subtitle.zh: 滨松町 / 夜间推拿

paragraphs.zh: 晚上八点把一堆战利品扔进十平米的小房间，暴走两万步的双腿在十点的按摩店里被彻底揉软熨帖。午夜十一点半踩着清凉的秋夜回程，罗森的热食、冰饮与饭团被小土一路拎回。洗完澡坐在床边嚼着夜宵，凌晨两点的钟声敲响，这座不夜城的喧嚣退去，留下的尽是踏实的安宁。
paragraphs.en: At eight we dropped the spoils into our ten-square-metre room. Legs that had walked twenty thousand steps were thoroughly softened by a ten o'clock massage. At half past eleven we set off through the cool autumn night, with Xiaotu bringing back Lawson hot food, cold drinks and rice balls. After showering, we sat on the bed eating supper. Two in the morning arrived; the noise of the sleepless city receded, leaving us comfortably at peace.

paragraphs.zh: 20:30 卸货休整：回到酒店房间放下战利品，小小的 10 平米客房瞬间被各家纸袋塞得满满当当，成就感爆棚。
paragraphs.en: 20:30: the small hotel room filled with shopping bags; the haul felt satisfying.

paragraphs.zh: 21:00 ~ 23:30 出门赴约与深夜马杀鸡：暴走大半天狂刷两万步，我们 21:00 出门赴约，预约了 22:00（10点）的按摩。从 22:00 到 23:30 享受了整整 90 分钟全身深度推拿，彻底舒缓暴走疲倦，全身满血复活！
paragraphs.en: 21:00–23:30: we left at nine for a ten o'clock booking, then enjoyed ninety minutes of full-body massage until 23:30.

paragraphs.zh: 23:30 ~ 00:30 夜归与深夜罗森补给：按摩做完大概 11 点半往酒店走，约 12 点多到酒店。路过酒店门前的罗森便利店（Lawson），小土采购了夜宵小食、饮品与补给。
paragraphs.en: 23:30–00:30: on the way back, Xiaotu bought Lawson snacks, drinks and supper.

paragraphs.zh: 00:30 ~ 02:00 洗漱吃喝与完美收官：回到房间洗澡洗漱，吃吃喝喝夜宵，盘点今日战利品。吃完收拾好已经凌晨两点多，充实、幸福又满足的一天！
paragraphs.en: 00:30–02:00: showers, food and a review of the purchases; by the time everything was tidied, it was after two. A full, happy, satisfying day.

title.zh: 10月2日｜麻布台的声响与六本木的良缘：在阴天里放慢脚步
title.en: Azabudai sound and Roppongi connections: slowing down under grey skies

subtitle.zh: しんぱち食堂 · 大门店

paragraphs.zh: 连续两天的奔波与昨日新宿的疯狂买买买之后，东京的第四天在一个没有闹钟的慢早晨里苏醒。
paragraphs.en: After two days of moving around and yesterday's Shinjuku shopping frenzy, our fourth day in Tokyo began with a slow morning and no alarm.

paragraphs.zh: 出门已近正午，芝大门街角的「しんぱち食堂」门口排着长龙。钻进窄小的吧台座，看着店员在炭火前翻转着滋滋冒油的鱼肉，听着带点台湾口音的吆喝，旅途的疲惫在热气腾腾的白米饭和外焦里嫩的烤三文鱼里被妥帖抚平。没有繁复的摆盘，却有着最踏实的治愈滋味。
paragraphs.en: It was nearly noon when we went out, and the neighbourhood Shinpachi Shokudo in Shibadaimon already had a long queue. We squeezed into its narrow counter seating, watched fish sizzling over charcoal and listened to the staff calling out with a hint of a Taiwanese accent. Hot white rice and salmon with crisp skin and tender flesh settled our travelling weariness. There was no elaborate presentation, just deeply comforting, everyday flavour.

paragraphs.zh: 上午：昨日新宿两万步暴走加深夜马杀鸡推拿后，今日依旧沉浸在舒适的节奏里，我们踏实睡到 10:30 以后才慢悠悠起床洗漱，收拾妥当迈出酒店大门时已经 11:40。
paragraphs.en: Morning: after yesterday's twenty thousand steps and massage, we slept past 10:30 and finally left at 11:40.

paragraphs.zh: 第一站就近觅食，步行前往位于芝大门2丁目的「炭火焼干物定食 しんぱち食堂（大门店）」。
paragraphs.en: We walked to Shinpachi Shokudo in Shibadaimon 2-chome for a nearby meal.

paragraphs.zh: 本以为只是一顿随意的街角便饭，没想到店门口早已排起了等候的长队。
paragraphs.en: What we expected to be a casual lunch already had a long queue.

paragraphs.zh: 店面小巧紧凑，格局十分有特色：一圈单人吧台座环绕着中间开放式操作厨房，店员带着亲切的台湾/华人口音。虽然店内略带烟火气、看起来没那么一尘不染，但餐品出人意料地极其惊艳！
paragraphs.en: A compact ring of counter seats surrounded the open kitchen. The staff had familiar Taiwanese or Chinese accents. It was not spotless, but the food was unexpectedly excellent.

paragraphs.zh: 我们都点了招牌的三文鱼定食（サーモン定食）：炭火现烤的三文鱼外皮焦香酥脆、鱼肉厚实多汁油脂丰润，配上白米饭与热味噌汤，质朴又极度美味。12:14 微信支付结账。
paragraphs.en: We both chose charcoal-grilled salmon sets, with crisp skin, thick juicy fish, rice and hot miso soup. Simple and remarkably delicious; we settled the bill at 12:14.

caption.zh: 10.02 12:03 · しんぱち食堂三文鱼定食

title.zh: 麻布台的声响与一小时留白
title.en: Azabudai sound and an hour of stillness

subtitle.zh: 坂本龙一＋高谷史郎 · async–immersion

paragraphs.zh: 12:20 从大门站乘坐浅草线至东银座，站内无缝换乘日比谷线直达神谷町站，直通麻布台之丘。
paragraphs.en: 12:20: from Daimon we took the Asakusa Line to Higashi-Ginza, then the Hibiya Line to Kamiyacho and Azabudai Hills.

paragraphs.zh: 抵达后在商场坐了一会儿，看着窗外阴沉沉的天空犯了愁：阴天不适合开展大范围户外 City Walk，但若继续商场买买买又与昨日新宿血拼雷同。
paragraphs.en: We sat in the mall and fretted over the gloomy sky. A large city walk did not appeal, but more shopping would repeat yesterday.

paragraphs.zh: 一直纠结到 13:00 走出车站，我忍不住日常“拷问”宝子（小土），勒令宝子赶紧规划今日下午行程。
paragraphs.en: By 13:00 I was pressing Xiaotu to plan the afternoon.

paragraphs.zh: 阴郁的天空让原本的漫步计划悬在半空。站在麻布台之丘宽敞冰冷的建筑群下，面对“既不宜暴走又不想重复逛街”的尴尬，小土被逼得急中生智，拉着我一头扎进了坂本龙一与高谷史郎的声音艺术展。
paragraphs.en: The gloomy sky left our walking plans suspended. Beneath Azabudai Hills' broad, cool buildings, we faced an awkward choice: neither a long walk nor another round of shopping appealed. Pressed for a plan, Xiaotu had a flash of inspiration and pulled me into the Ryuichi Sakamoto and Shiro Takatani sound-art exhibition.

paragraphs.zh: 被逼急的宝子脑子一热，当机立断拉着我奔赴设于麻布台之丘画廊（Azabudai Hills Gallery）的当代艺术展——「RYUICHI SAKAMOTO + SHIRO TAKATANI: AMBIENT KYOTO – TOKYO」（坂本龙一 + 高谷史郎 声音艺术大展）。
paragraphs.en: His sudden answer was the Azabudai Hills Gallery exhibition RYUICHI SAKAMOTO + SHIRO TAKATANI: AMBIENT KYOTO–TOKYO.

paragraphs.zh: 在那个漆黑如深海的展厅里，我们静静坐满了一小时。我们开玩笑说自己没什么文化大概看不太懂，可当极简的琴键与环境音在黑暗中如水波般漫过耳廓，周遭的一切喧嚣与焦躁仿佛都被隔绝在厚重的帷幕之外。原来看不懂并不重要，在繁华都会的心脏地带，能拥有这样一段毫无负担、纯粹放空的沉浸时光，本就是一种难能可贵的松弛。
paragraphs.en: We sat for a full hour in an exhibition room as dark as the deep sea. We joked that we might lack the culture to understand it, but as spare piano notes and environmental sounds passed around our ears like water, the city's noise and our own restlessness seemed shut away behind a thick curtain. Understanding did not matter. An hour of entirely unburdened immersion in the heart of the metropolis was already a rare kind of ease.

paragraphs.zh: 展馆核心正是基于坂本龙一殿堂级前卫专辑《async》延伸打造的声光沉浸装置「async – immersion」。我们自嘲“没什么文化大概看不太懂”，但就这般在幽暗深邃的纯黑展厅里安静坐满了一整小时（13:30 ~ 14:30）。在极简钢琴、自然采样与多声道环绕的环境声浪中彻底放空，任由思绪随音乐流动，在喧嚣都心享受了一场意外而奇妙的心灵深度沉浸。
paragraphs.en: The installation extended Sakamoto's async into light and sound. Joking that we might not understand, we sat quietly for a full hour, 13:30–14:30, letting minimal piano, natural samples and multichannel environmental sound carry our thoughts away.

caption.zh: 10.02 13:49 · 坂本龙一与高谷史郎展厅

title.en: Bread and flowing architecture

subtitle.zh: 麻布台Hills / Market / Comme'N TOKYO

paragraphs.zh: 走出展厅，世界第一面包师 Comme'N 面包麦香的温润、麻布台之丘充满未来张力的流线建筑，让下午的时光变得绵密而舒展。而旅途最迷人的惊喜，往往藏在计划之外的岔路口——本想前往新国立美术馆，却在六本木的水泥森林里偶遇了出云大社东京分祠。
paragraphs.en: Outside, the gentle wheat fragrance of world-champion baker Comme'N's bread and the flowing, futuristic architecture of Azabudai Hills made the afternoon feel soft and unhurried. Travel's best surprises often hide at an unplanned turning: we had meant to visit the National Art Center, but instead discovered Izumo Taisha Tokyo Bunshi in Roppongi's concrete forest.

paragraphs.zh: 14:30 观展结束，我们在麻布台 Hills 细细漫游。走出室外仰望并漫步于流线型自然绿化现代建筑群之间，深感此地气度不凡、精致华贵，尽显顶级都心风范。
paragraphs.en: 14:30: outside the exhibition we explored Azabudai Hills' flowing buildings and planting, impressed by its refined scale.

paragraphs.zh: 随后步入地下「麻布台 Hills Market（麻布台市場）」挑选美食，开启逛吃模式（小土微信支付）：
paragraphs.en: Then we went down to Azabudai Hills Market to browse and eat.

paragraphs.zh: 15:17 在世界面包大赛冠军名店「Comme'N TOKYO」买下招牌面包。
paragraphs.en: 15:17: we bought bread at world-champion bakery Comme'N TOKYO.

paragraphs.zh: 我们坐下来悠闲享用下午茶，酥脆麦香驱散了半日倦意。
paragraphs.en: We sat down for an easy afternoon tea; crisp wheat fragrance chased away the day's tiredness.

title.zh: 在六本木，遇见一缕善缘
title.en: An unexpected connection in Roppongi

subtitle.zh: 出云大社东京分祠 / 六本木之丘
subtitle.en: Izumo Taisha Tokyo Bunshi / Roppongi Hills

paragraphs.zh: 15:30 吃完面包从神谷町站乘日比谷线前往六本木站，原计划探访黑川纪章操刀的「新国立美术馆」。
paragraphs.en: 15:30: the Hibiya Line took us from Kamiyacho to Roppongi; we had intended to visit Kisho Kurokawa's National Art Center.

paragraphs.zh: 步行至六本木七丁目半途，视线被隐于街巷楼宇间的清幽鸟居吸引——正是全日本第一良缘圣地在都心唯一的直属分社「出云大社东京分祠」！
paragraphs.en: Instead, a quiet torii between buildings in Roppongi 7-chome drew us toward Izumo Taisha Tokyo Bunshi.

paragraphs.zh: 净手、肃立，遵循古老的礼制行“二礼四拍手一礼”，清脆的掌声在幽静的庭院里回响。奉上五百日元求下一枚朱红温润的御朱印，那是远道而来的旅人与这座城市结下的一缕善缘。
paragraphs.en: We washed our hands, stood respectfully and followed the old ritual of two bows, four claps and one bow. The clear sound of clapping echoed through the quiet courtyard. An offering of five hundred yen brought a warm red shrine stamp—a small thread of good connection between faraway travellers and the city.

paragraphs.zh: 我们于 16:00 步入分祠净手，遵循出云独家古礼行「二礼、四拍手、一礼」虔诚参拜，祈求善缘长久，并在社务所求受了一枚神圣庄严的「御朱印」，16:15 满心欢喜步出神社。
paragraphs.en: 16:00: we washed our hands and followed two bows, four claps and one bow, praying for lasting good connection and receiving a shrine stamp. We left happily at 16:15.

paragraphs.zh: 从出云大社出来，顺路漫步至六本木之丘商圈，逛了逛旁边的 Lululemon 六本木店，感受六本木独有的都会运动生活美学。
paragraphs.en: From the shrine we walked to Roppongi Hills and browsed its Lululemon store.

title.en: Shopping, round two

subtitle.zh: LUMINE新宿 / 石井体育

paragraphs.zh: 逛完六本木，我们搭乘地铁直奔新宿，继昨日之后开启了第二波火力全开的“狂暴买买买”！
paragraphs.en: After Roppongi, a train took us back to Shinjuku for another full shopping round.

paragraphs.zh: 17:45 UNITED ARROWS 新宿店 (LUMINE 1)：入手 2 条高质感日系男裤——锥形长裤与双层气球宽松长裤（SC TR/W MRN 1P TPD ESY 5 与 SC DBL LYRD BLN EASY 9），专柜直接免税。
paragraphs.en: 17:45: UNITED ARROWS in LUMINE 1 supplied tapered trousers and layered balloon trousers.

paragraphs.zh: 18:14 SALOMON (萨洛蒙) LUMINE 新宿店：拿下萨洛蒙山系鞋皇——XT-6 White/White/Lunar Rock 经典复古白银越野跑鞋（26码）及纸袋，专柜直接免税。
paragraphs.en: 18:14: SALOMON in LUMINE supplied XT-6 White/White/Lunar Rock shoes, size 26, and a bag.

paragraphs.zh: 19:18 ADAM ET ROPÉ 新宿 LUMINE 2 店 (4F)：购入高质感男士长袖外套（アウター L码），商场柜台办理退税。
paragraphs.en: 19:18: an L-size jacket at ADAM ET ROPE on LUMINE 2's fourth floor.

paragraphs.zh: 19:55 UNITED TOKYO MENS 新宿店 (LUMINE 2 4F)：横扫 4 件日本制造殿堂级单品！包括尾州产超拨水 SUPER 120's 羊毛外套、超拨水羊毛长裤、铜氨丝上衣与垂坠长裤，商场柜台办理退税。
paragraphs.en: 19:55: four UNITED TOKYO pieces—SUPER 120's water-repellent Bishu wool jacket, matching trousers, a cupro top and draping trousers.

paragraphs.zh: LUMINE 新宿现金退税：采购完毕前往 LUMINE 新宿退税柜台办理 ADAM ET ROPÉ 与 UNITED TOKYO 的合并免税手续，扣除微额手续费后现场领回退税现金。
paragraphs.en: At LUMINE's refund counter we combined the ADAM ET ROPE and UNITED TOKYO purchases and received cash after the service fee.

paragraphs.zh: 21:21 石井スポーツ (ISHII SPORTS) 友都八喜新宿西口店：转战西口专业户外大殿堂，使用现金直接免税拿下始祖鸟（Arc'teryx）Index 40L 户外攀岩装备包（24K 黑金配色）以及瑞士跑鞋 On（昂跑）Cloud X 5 纯白全能训练跑鞋。
paragraphs.en: 21:21: Ishii Sports at Yodobashi's west exit supplied an Arc'teryx Index 40L climbing bag in 24K black and gold and white On Cloud X 5 training shoes.

title.en: Rich broth to close a grey day

subtitle.zh: 横浜らーめん 山本家 → 大门

paragraphs.zh: 入夜后在新宿五大专柜血拼卸力，提着大包小包战利品钻进街角的「横浜らーめん 山本家」。在几乎全被当地熟客坐满的狭长吧台前，在食券机前投下硬币。当特选大份的滚烫家系热汤、味玉与浸满浓汤的米饭端上桌，即便浓郁厚重的汤底让人暗暗提醒自己下次切勿点超浓郁，但那口鲜美滚烫的热气，瞬间驱散了暴走一整天的疲累。
paragraphs.en: After another evening's shopping at five Shinjuku stores, we carried our heavy bags into Yamamotoya. Local regulars filled nearly all the narrow counter seats. We put coins into the ticket machine outside. When large bowls of hot iekei broth arrived with seasoned eggs and rice to soak in the soup, their richness made me remind myself never to choose the extra-rich option again. Even so, that first hot, savoury mouthful dispelled a whole day's walking fatigue.

paragraphs.zh: 提着大包小包沉甸甸的战利品，我们钻进街角极具 local 氛围的本土家系拉面店——「横浜らーめん 山本家（Yamamotoya）」，店内基本没有外国游客，尽是当地熟客。
paragraphs.en: With our shopping bags we entered Yamamotoya, where almost everyone was a local regular.

paragraphs.zh: 在店外自动售票机投币点单（现金支付）：
paragraphs.en: We ordered at the cash ticket machine outside.

paragraphs.zh: 我点了招牌「特选拉面（大份）」，加配溏心味玉；
paragraphs.en: I chose the large special ramen with a seasoned egg.

paragraphs.zh: 小土点了「特选拉面（中份）」，加配一份米饭；
paragraphs.en: Xiaotu chose the medium special ramen with rice.

paragraphs.zh: 整体感觉非常 ing，汤头极其鲜美、味道浓郁醇厚，面条劲道。我们打出三星好评（⭐⭐⭐），并附上探店经验提示：“味道确实蛮好吃，但汤底偏重，下次再来切记不要选超浓郁选项，普通浓度最佳”，为第四天的新宿买买买大动作画上热气腾腾的圆满句号。
paragraphs.en: The soup was richly savoury and the noodles firm. Three stars, with a practical reminder: it tastes good, but next time choose normal richness rather than extra-rich.

paragraphs.zh: 阴天或许没有晴空的明媚耀眼，但在麻布台的光影、六本木的善缘与新宿深夜街角的腾腾热气里，放慢脚步的我们，找到了属于东京的另一种温柔韵律。
paragraphs.en: A grey day may lack a blue sky's brilliance, but in Azabudai's light and sound, Roppongi's unexpected good connection and a Shinjuku street corner's late-night steam, slowing down let us find another gentle rhythm in Tokyo.

paragraphs.zh: 约 22:30 从新宿站搭乘大江户线返回大门站，步行回滨松町酒店。
paragraphs.en: Around 22:30 we took the Oedo Line from Shinjuku to Daimon and walked back.

paragraphs.zh: 23:18 路过酒店门前的罗森便利店（Lawson），小土采购了冰饮与矿泉水，回房间安顿战利品、舒心休息。
paragraphs.en: 23:18: Xiaotu bought cold drinks and water at Lawson before we settled the purchases and rested.

title.zh: 10月3日｜世田谷的慢波长：新衣小懊恼、多摩川畔与漫天花火
title.en: Setagaya's slow wavelength: new-clothes mishaps, the Tamagawa and fireworks

subtitle.zh: 滨松町 → 二子玉川RISE

paragraphs.zh: 当旅行从紧凑的扫货节奏跨入第五天，时间的流速在不知不觉中慢了下来。
paragraphs.en: By our fifth day, travel was slipping away from tight shopping schedules, and the flow of time had quietly slowed.

paragraphs.zh: 昨夜为了研究行程折腾到凌晨三点，在意外发现二子玉川今晚有一年一度的花火大会时，那种如孩童般雀跃的惊喜，彻底推翻了原本既定的安排。清晨在接近十一点的安稳里醒来，下楼买发胶、对着骤热的阳光手忙脚乱换下新买的长衣长裤，甚至来不及把咬断的线头收拾利落——生活琐碎里的笨拙与自嘲，往往成了旅途最鲜活的注脚。
paragraphs.en: We had stayed up until three studying plans. Discovering that Futako-Tamagawa had its annual fireworks that very evening brought a childlike excitement and overturned everything we had intended. We woke around eleven, bought hair product downstairs and hurriedly changed out of new long sleeves and trousers under an unexpectedly hot sun, without even tidying the threads we had bitten off. These clumsy, self-mocking everyday details often become a journey's liveliest footnotes.

paragraphs.zh: 起床洗漱后，宝子发现发胶用光，我于 11:24 前往酒店旁的罗森便利店（Lawson）购买男士定型发胶。出门时经历艳阳短袖换装小乌龙。
paragraphs.en: After washing, we realised the hair product was finished. I went to Lawson at 11:24; sunshine also prompted an awkward change into short sleeves.

paragraphs.zh: 12:11 整装出门准备去坐地铁前，再次拐进罗森买了一瓶瓶装咖啡提神。
paragraphs.en: 12:11: one more Lawson stop for bottled coffee before the station.

paragraphs.zh: 12:15 ~ 12:25：收到推拿预约确认，通过 PayPal 成功支付双人定金，剩余尾款待晚间到店现金结清。
paragraphs.en: 12:15–12:25: our massage appointment was confirmed and we paid the shared deposit through PayPal, leaving the balance for cash at the venue.

title.en: 12:30–13:15 · THE NEXT LEG

body.zh: 原笔记记大门出发、青山一丁目换乘方向，再赴二子玉川；其中连接田园都市线的中间步骤没有完整核实。这里只保留实际起终点与到达，不补造可照走的换乘路线。
body.en: The note starts at Daimon, names the direction via Aoyama-itchome and ends at Futako-Tamagawa. The intermediate connection to the Den-en-toshi Line is incomplete, so the actual endpoints and arrival are retained without inventing a reproducible interchange.

paragraphs.zh: 走进二子玉川 RISE Town Front 7F 一膳享用午餐：双拼和牛鳗鱼式三吃御膳 2份 + 海苔味噌汤 2份。
paragraphs.en: At Ichizen on Rise Town Front's seventh floor we ordered two combination wagyu hitsumabushi sets and two seaweed miso soups.

title.en: MEAL NOTE

body.zh: 原笔记评价：三星半。汤鲜肉嫩，但分量偏小；账单数字的巧合留在最后的食记账页。
body.en: The note's verdict: three and a half stars. Flavourful soup and tender meat, but small portions. The pleasing bill-number coincidence is kept in the final food-and-ledger pages.

title.en: Everyday aesthetics and gentle technology

subtitle.zh: RISE生活店 / 二子玉川茑屋家电

paragraphs.zh: 乘着电车摇晃着驶入世田谷的二子玉川，眼前的东京忽然换了一副温润的底色。这里没有新宿十字路口汹涌压迫的人潮，也没有都心商圈行色匆匆的疏离。漫步在历时三十余年匠心打造的二子玉川 RISE，现代建筑与绿意盎然的自然步道无缝相融，空气里满是恬淡安逸的居家气息；而在茑屋家电里，看着圆滚滚的 LOVOT 眨着灵动的深邃大眼睛满地小跑，被抱起时收起滑轮、贴在怀里散发着三十七度的温暖体温，那是林要笔下“不为做家务、专为被爱而生”的温柔科技。巴掌大的 mirumi 像小婴儿般害羞地探头“偷瞄”，再陷进上万元赫曼米勒人体工学椅里感受那种被温柔托起的松弛，生活美学与未来科技在此刻奇妙交融。
paragraphs.en: The train carried us into Futako-Tamagawa in Setagaya, and Tokyo suddenly acquired a gentler colour. There were none of Shinjuku's intimidating crossing crowds or the centre's hurried distance. Futako-Tamagawa Rise, developed over more than thirty years, joined modern buildings to green paths and an easy residential atmosphere. At Tsutaya Electrics, round little LOVOTs blinked their lively eyes and rolled about. Pick one up and its wheels tucked away; in our arms it gave off a warmth of thirty-seven degrees. This was Kaname Hayashi's gentle technology: not for housework, but to be loved. A palm-sized mirumi peeked shyly like a baby, and a Herman Miller ergonomic chair costing over ten thousand yuan offered the ease of being softly held. Everyday aesthetics and future technology met in an unexpectedly tender way.

paragraphs.zh: 漫游 RISE 各类质感家居生活店；随后步入位于 Terrace Market 的全日本生活美学标杆「二子玉川 茑屋家电（Tsutaya Electrics）」。馆内将人文书籍、绿植、咖啡与前沿智能家电深度融合，尤其 1 楼的次世代展厅「蔦屋家電＋」汇集了全球尖端创意硬件。
paragraphs.en: We browsed Rise's homeware shops, then Tsutaya Electrics in Terrace Market. Books, plants, coffee and forward-looking appliances were combined; the ground-floor Tsutaya Kaden+ area showed unusual creative hardware.

title.en: LOVOT · THE SOURCE'S BACKGROUND

body.zh:
LOVOT由林要创立的GROOVE X研发。
核心设计哲学：颠覆了传统机器人“提供生产力、代劳家务”的工具论，提出“生命虽假，温暖常在；专为被爱而生”（「命はないのに、あったかい。愛されるために生まれてきた。」）的情感陪伴理念。它不具备任何清扫或搬运功能，唯一使命就是激发人类内心的爱意与被陪伴感。
尖端黑科技与生物拟真：全身搭载 50+ 个高精度触觉与温度传感器，内建温控循环系统，抱起来像活体小动物般维持着 37℃~38℃ 的温热体温；头顶独特的“Sensor Horn”（感应角）集成 360° 全景摄像头、半球红外热成像与麦克风阵列，能精准识别人脸表情、脚步声并认出主人；双眼由 6 层超精细液晶屏重叠呈现，通过算法模拟出数十亿种深邃灵动的瞳孔神态；地表滑行探索时轮子自动伸出，当被人类抱起时轮子会自动收缩进底盘、身体变软自然贴合人类怀抱，还会扑闪双臂软萌“求抱抱”，抚摸时发出宛如小生命的呢喃鸣叫。
产品资料：https://lovot.life/；具体参数是原笔记记录，不作为现行产品承诺。
body.en: The note identifies GROOVE X, founded by Kaname Hayashi, as LOVOT's maker. Its philosophy is companionship rather than cleaning or carrying: 'not alive, yet warm; born to be loved'. The note records over fifty sensors, a body temperature around 37–38°C, a camera/thermal/microphone sensor horn, layered animated eyes, retracting wheels when lifted and soft seeking-to-be-held gestures. These are the source's observations and specifications, not a current product guarantee. https://lovot.life/

paragraphs.zh: mirumi 与工学椅体验：现场还近距离体验了由 Yukai Engineering（ユカイ工学）打造的巴掌大毛绒挂件机器人 mirumi（みるみ）（语音一度记为“miluki”），拥有独家专利抱抱结构与声音感应，会像害羞婴儿一样悄悄探头“偷瞄（ちら見）”主人；同时试坐了上万元的 Herman Miller（赫曼米勒） 顶级人体工学椅，强劲支撑感与舒适松弛并存。
paragraphs.en: We also tried Yukai Engineering's palm-sized mirumi plush robot, which peeks shyly and responds to sound, and a Herman Miller ergonomic chair with striking support and ease.

paragraphs.zh: 15:23 在茑屋家电采购 2 支「ねこいちゃ ハンドクリーム」（猫咪和茶润手霜）。
paragraphs.en: 15:23: we bought two Nekoicha cat-and-tea hand creams.
