title.zh: 人潮、烤串与临时找机位
title.en: Crowds, missed skewers and a search for a view

subtitle.zh: 多摩川河川敷 → 玉川高岛屋

paragraphs.zh: 然而，旅途总有计划之外的荒诞与波澜。傍晚本想信步去公园散步，却一头扎进了数十万观赏花火的人潮长龙里。短短一段路挪了半小时，放眼望去皆是铺满河滩的野餐垫与冒着香气的小吃摊。宝子眼巴巴地看着滋滋作响的烤串，提议买几串垫着塑料袋坐下，而焦急担心散场瘫痪的我却一心只想撤离，拉着宝子匆匆折返，让那份心心念念的烤串成了下午未竟的小小遗憾。在高岛屋借洗手间偶遇了让人目瞪口呆的“小便池惊魂”与被吓哭找妈妈的小男孩，坐在六楼星巴克捧着一杯温润的日本茶拿铁，连露台被封都无法阻挡我们寻找视野的兴致。
paragraphs.en: But travel also brings absurdity and upheaval outside any plan. We had meant to stroll in a park and instead walked straight into an immense queue of fireworks watchers. A short stretch took half an hour; the riverbank was covered in picnic mats and fragrant food stalls. Xiaotu watched the sizzling skewers hopefully and suggested buying some and sitting on a plastic bag. Worried about a paralysed station after the show, I only wanted to retreat, pulling him away and leaving the skewers as the afternoon's small unfinished wish. At Takashimaya's toilets came a jaw-dropping 'urinal shock' and a little boy frightened enough to look for his mother. Upstairs in the sixth-floor Starbucks, a Japanese tea latte—and even a closed rooftop—could not stop our determination to find a view.

paragraphs.zh: 约 16:15 走向多摩川河川敷，随望不到头的人龙队伍挪动半小时，于 17:00 抵达二子玉川绿地运动场核心会场。
paragraphs.en: Around 16:15 we headed for the riverbank and shuffled through a long queue for half an hour, reaching the sports-ground venue around 17:00.

paragraphs.zh: 草地密布几十万野餐垫，河边屋台烤串滋滋飘香，宝子嘴馋提议买烤串垫塑料袋坐下看，但我担心几十万人散场瘫痪车站而坚持撤退，宝子吃烤串心愿落空。17:00 逆向撤出会场。
paragraphs.en: Picnic mats filled the grass and skewers smelled wonderful. Xiaotu wanted to eat and sit on a plastic bag, but I feared the station crush after the show and insisted we leave. His skewer wish was left unfinished.

paragraphs.zh: 前往「玉川高岛屋 S・C」借用洗手间，目睹小便池拉大便奇观，日本小男孩当场吓哭找妈妈。
paragraphs.en: At Takashimaya's toilets came the extraordinary sight of someone defecating in a urinal; a little boy was frightened enough to go looking for his mother.

paragraphs.zh: 17:31 抵达高岛屋 6 楼星巴克购买宝子喜爱的日本茶拿铁等饮品。
paragraphs.en: 17:31: on the sixth floor, Starbucks supplied Xiaotu's favourite Japanese tea latte and other drinks.

paragraphs.zh: 发现顶楼天台封锁，向 Gemini 与 ChatGPT 咨询野景机位，果断向会场外围开阔干道转移。
paragraphs.en: The rooftop was closed. We asked Gemini and ChatGPT about possible views and moved toward open roads outside the core venue.

title.en: FIREWORKS NOTE

body.zh: 这次没有在核心会场坐定，也没有上成高岛屋天台。外围观看时不能堵塞通道，现场安排并非固定机位保证。https://tamagawa-hanabi.com/
body.en: We did not settle in the core venue or reach Takashimaya's roof. Watching from the surrounding roads meant keeping passages clear; this is not a guaranteed fixed viewpoint. https://tamagawa-hanabi.com/

title.en: An autumn night of brilliance over the Tamagawa

subtitle.zh: 边走边看的花火

paragraphs.zh: 六点整，第一枚礼炮在夜空中轰然炸裂！沿着开阔通道边走边看，漫天盛放的烟火照亮了多摩川的秋夜，声光激荡、绚烂至极。即便一路上被执勤保安催促着前行不能久留，但那种仰头望向天际时瞳孔里倒映的漫天璀璨，依然让我们由衷感叹——哪怕只是在奔跑与回眸中相遇，东京的花火也从未辜负远道而来期的期盼。
paragraphs.en: At exactly six, the first report burst across the night sky. We watched while walking along open roads as brilliant fireworks lit the Tamagawa's autumn night, all sound and light. Security staff kept urging us onward, so we could not linger. Still, looking up and finding that brightness reflected in our eyes made us feel that, even when encountered between hurried steps and backward glances, Tokyo's fireworks had not let down the hopes of travellers from afar.

paragraphs.zh: 18:00 礼炮轰鸣，一年一度多摩川花火盛大绽放！沿开阔干道边走边看，声光激荡、绚烂至极。
paragraphs.en: 18:00: the reports sounded and the annual Tamagawa fireworks began. We watched along open roads while walking, struck by the sound and light.

title.zh: 自由之丘的晚饭与九十分钟卸力
title.en: Jiyugaoka dinner and ninety minutes to unwind

subtitle.zh: 大户屋 → 新宿三丁目

paragraphs.zh: 七点跳上电车，误打误撞闯入了充满烟火气与法式优雅的自由之丘。大户屋热气腾腾的定食熨帖了空空的胃囊，新宿三丁目闭店后的街头长椅上完成了日常的多邻国打卡，最后在九点钟准时躺下，享受离京前最后一次长达九十分钟的深度推拿。
paragraphs.en: At seven we jumped onto a train and unexpectedly found ourselves in Jiyugaoka, a neighbourhood with everyday bustle and a touch of French elegance. Ootoya's steaming set meals comforted our empty stomachs. On a bench in Shinjuku-sanchome's closed-shop streets we completed our daily Duolingo check-in, then lay down promptly at nine for one last ninety-minute massage before leaving Tokyo.

paragraphs.zh: 19:00 掐准散场大客流瘫痪前跳上东急大井町线，二子玉川至自由之丘，约 19:15 抵埗自由之丘。
paragraphs.en: 19:00: we caught the Oimachi Line to Jiyugaoka before the main dispersal, arriving about 19:15.

paragraphs.zh: 步入「大戸屋ごはん処 自由が丘南口店」（地下1F）享用晚餐：炭火烤鸡亲子丼定食  + 白饭大盛  + 每日定食  + 升级蘑菇滑菇汤  + 烤花鱼 。
paragraphs.en: At Ootoya's south-exit branch in basement one, we ordered grilled-chicken oyakodon, extra rice, the daily set, an upgraded mushroom soup and grilled hokke.

paragraphs.zh: 19:43 结账。小土亲子丼略偏咸。
paragraphs.en: 19:43: the bill was settled. Xiaotu's oyakodon was slightly too salty.

paragraphs.zh: 19:50 从自由之丘搭乘东急东横线（直通东京地下铁副都心线）前往新宿三丁目。
paragraphs.en: 19:50: the Toyoko Line through onto the Fukutoshin Line took us to Shinjuku-sanchome.

paragraphs.zh: 20:30 走出地铁，在按摩馆外的长椅上吹风歇脚，完成今日多邻国打卡。
paragraphs.en: 20:30: we rested in the breeze on the bench outside the massage place and completed today's Duolingo check-in.

paragraphs.zh: 21:00 准时进店，享受整整 90 分钟全身深度推拿，现场以现金结清双人尾款，彻底揉散连日两万步暴走的疲劳，满血复活。
paragraphs.en: 21:00: ninety minutes of deep full-body massage, settling the balance in cash and easing days of walking fatigue.

title.en: Seventy-five metres to fulfil the skewer wish

subtitle.zh: 大门 → 鸟贵族浜松町店

paragraphs.zh: 从按摩馆走出来时已近深夜十一点，推拿揉散了连日暴走的酸软，浑身通透舒展。坐上大江户线回到大门站，本想着钻进便利店买个冰杯回房间喝点冰饮就睡，身旁的小土却忽然馋虫大动，嚷嚷着想吃烤串。原来，早在下午多摩川河滩的小吃摊前悄悄种下的馋意，在心底兜转了一整天从未熄灭。
paragraphs.en: It was nearly eleven when we emerged from the massage. The soreness from days of walking had been kneaded away, and everything felt loose and light. Back at Daimon on the Oedo Line, we had only meant to buy an ice cup from a convenience store and take cold drinks back to the room. Then Xiaotu announced that he wanted skewers. The craving planted at the Tamagawa stalls that afternoon had circled quietly inside him all day.

paragraphs.zh: 23:00 从新宿三丁目搭乘都营大江户线返回大门站，23:30 顺利出站。
paragraphs.en: 23:00: the Oedo Line returned us to Daimon; we emerged at 23:30.

paragraphs.zh: 出站原本打算去便利店买冰杯回酒店喝饮品，宝子突然馋虫大动想吃烤串——下午在花火会场未吃成烤串的执念在心底兜转了一整天！
paragraphs.en: We had meant to buy an ice cup for drinks at the hotel, but Xiaotu wanted skewers—the ones missed at the fireworks venue had stayed on his mind.

caption.zh: 10.03 23:39 · 滨松町夜街 / 东京塔
10.03 23:45 · 滨松町夜街 / 东京塔

paragraphs.zh: 掏出手机顺手一搜，赫然发现就在 75 米开外的拐角处，竟然藏着一家金黄招牌的鸟贵族！那还有什么好犹疑的？当即踩着夜色推门而入。午夜十二点的居酒屋里依然人声鼎沸、烤炉上滋滋冒油，冰饮碰杯、炭火焦香，我们在喧闹的市井烟火里大嚼着刚出炉的烤串。白天因匆忙撤退而错过的遗憾，在午夜温暖的炭火与肉香中被彻底抚平，心愿终得达成。一边大快朵颐，一边忍不住自嘲‘这趟旅行感觉要胖死了’。
paragraphs.en: One quick phone search revealed a golden Torikizoku sign only seventy-five metres around the corner. What was there to hesitate about? We stepped through the night and into the restaurant. Even at midnight the izakaya was lively and the grill sizzled. Cold drinks clinked, charcoal smelled wonderful and we ate freshly grilled skewers in the cheerful neighbourhood noise. The regret of leaving the riverbank hurriedly was smoothed away by warm meat and fire; the wish was finally fulfilled. Eating happily, we could not help joking, 'This trip is going to make us so fat.'

paragraphs.zh: 随手打开 Google Maps 一搜，仅 75 米开外就是「鳥貴族 浜松町店」（浜松町1-30-11 FG大厦9楼）！
paragraphs.en: Google Maps showed Torikizoku only 75 metres away, on floor nine of the FG building at Hamamatsucho 1-30-11.

paragraphs.zh: 我们果断推门而入，19号桌落座。点了 5 串经典烧鸟：盐烤鸡胗、盐烤鸡心、盐烤鸡皮、招牌岩盐鸡腿贵族烧、招牌酱汁鸡胸贵族烧。
paragraphs.en: We sat at table 19 and chose five dishes: salt-grilled gizzard, heart and skin, rock-salt thigh and sauce-grilled breast.

paragraphs.zh: 10月4日 00:22 结账。心愿圆满达成，我们大快朵颐碰杯畅饮，自嘲“这趟旅行感觉要胖死了”！
paragraphs.en: The bill was settled at 00:22 on 4 October. We ate and toasted happily, joking that the journey was making us fat.

paragraphs.zh: 从清晨的换衣小乌龙、世田谷午后的机器人与工学椅，到多摩川仰头望见的漫天璀璨、自由之丘的大户屋、深夜的推拿，以及此刻午夜居酒屋里冒着热气的肉串——生活的跌宕起伏与心愿达成的极致升华，全都在这一碗一串的滚烫里，浪漫落定。
paragraphs.en: From the morning's clothing mishap, through Setagaya's robots and ergonomic chairs, the brilliance above the Tamagawa, Ootoya in Jiyugaoka and our late massage, to these hot skewers in a midnight izakaya: life's ups and downs and the delight of a wish fulfilled settled romantically into each warm bowl and skewer.

title.zh: 10月4日｜东京终章：光影交错、步履停歇与远行成田
title.en: Tokyo's final chapter: changing light, tired steps and the night to Narita

subtitle.zh: 滨松町 → 赤羽桥 → 饭仓熊野神社

paragraphs.zh: 旅行的最后一天，总是在一种既想抓住尾巴、又不得不向时间妥协的匆忙里展开。
paragraphs.en: A journey's last day always begins in a rush between wanting to hold on to its tail and having to make peace with time.

paragraphs.zh: 清晨不到九点半就强撑着爬起来收拾，原以为掐着十点出头下楼算得上井井有条，却在前台被工作人员一本正经地提醒：“本酒店退房时间是十点整哦。”那一瞬间的愕然与自嘲，成了对这家快捷酒店最深刻的告别——十六点入住、十点退房，十平米的逼仄与严苛的规矩，让我们异口同声地发誓：“下次再来，绝不再贪这便宜了。”
paragraphs.en: We dragged ourselves up before half past nine to pack. Reaching reception just after ten had seemed reasonably organised, until the staff solemnly reminded us, 'Checkout is at ten sharp.' That startled, self-mocking moment became our most lasting farewell to the budget hotel. Four o'clock check-in, ten o'clock checkout and ten cramped square metres made us both promise: next time, we would not choose it merely to save money.

paragraphs.zh: 由于今日要从港区退房转场，我早早于 09:30 起床洗漱、收拾行装准备离开。
paragraphs.en: 09:30: up early to wash and pack for our transfer.

paragraphs.zh: 10:10 拎着行李乘电梯下楼时，被前台工作人员提醒酒店退房时间是上午 10:00，令我们大吃一惊！仔细核对订房信息才发现，这家位于港区核心的快捷酒店（BAY HOTEL 东京滨松町）规矩极其严苛：下午 16:00 方可入住，而早上 10:00 必须退房。
paragraphs.en: 10:10: downstairs, reception reminded us checkout was at ten. The booking indeed allowed check-in only at 16:00 and required checkout at 10:00.

paragraphs.zh: 我们忍不住吐槽：“下次再来东京，绝不再订这种快捷酒店了。虽然房费便宜实惠，但房间实在逼仄狭小，入住与退房的时间也过于苛刻死板。”
paragraphs.en: We complained that next time we would not choose this kind of compact budget hotel: affordable, but cramped with rigid arrival and departure times.

paragraphs.zh: 10:30 顺利办妥退房手续，将大件行李寄存在酒店前台，我们轻装上阵，正式开启在东京市区的最后一天漫游。
paragraphs.en: 10:30: checkout completed, luggage stored, and we set off light for the last Tokyo day.

paragraphs.zh: 寄存完大包小包，轻装踏上大江户线。在赤羽桥钻出地面，晴空下的东京塔带着标志性的红白线条撞入眼帘。循着静谧的坡道漫步，竟意外撞进了一座藏于绿树阴翳中的古老神祠——饭仓熊野神社。一千三百年前由行基菩萨自熊野劝请、源赖信移奉于此的古老镇守，在寸土寸金的都心保持着独有的清幽。社务所的先生神情温和，在朱印本上落下一笔一画，右下角那只三足神鸟八咫乌，仿佛在默默为即将结束旅程的异乡人指引归途。
paragraphs.en: With the bags stored, we travelled light on the Oedo Line. Emerging at Akabanebashi, Tokyo Tower's familiar red and white rose into the clear autumn sky. Quiet sloping streets unexpectedly brought us to Iikura Kumano Shrine beneath the trees. This old guardian shrine, traditionally traced to Gyoki's invitation of the Kumano deity thirteen hundred years ago and its relocation by Minamoto no Yorinobu, kept a distinctive stillness in the densely built city. The shrine-office attendant wrote our stamp patiently, stroke by stroke. The three-legged yatagarasu at the lower right seemed to be quietly guiding these foreign travellers toward home.

paragraphs.zh: 今日第一站前往麻布台之丘观赏著名的 teamLab Borderless 展览。我们从大门站刷 Suica 进站，搭乘都营大江户线至赤羽桥站（Akabanebashi）下车，准备慢悠悠散步前往麻布台。
paragraphs.en: We took the Oedo Line from Daimon to Akabanebashi, intending to walk to Azabudai Hills for Borderless.

paragraphs.zh: 刚出地铁站，仰头便能近距离望见红白相间的东京塔巍然耸立在秋日晴空之下。我们漫步街巷，途中误打误撞走进了一座隐藏在闹市楼宇间的幽静小神祠——「饭仓熊野神社（飯倉熊野神社）」。
paragraphs.en: Tokyo Tower appeared just outside the station. The walk unexpectedly led to quiet Iikura Kumano Shrine between the buildings.

paragraphs.zh: 10:45 在神社社务所迎请并书写了今日份的御朱印，印有神圣的神鸟八咫乌印记。
paragraphs.en: 10:45: at the shrine office we received today's stamp, bearing the three-legged yatagarasu.

caption.zh: 10.04 10:45 · 饭仓熊野神社与御朱印
10.04 10:47 · 饭仓熊野神社与御朱印

title.en: SHRINE BACKGROUND FROM THE NOTE

body.zh:
千年古刹溯源：饭仓熊野神社（港区麻布台2丁目）是东京都内极为古老的熊野信仰名社。其渊源可追溯至奈良时代养老年代（公元 717～724 年），相传由高僧行基菩萨自和歌山熊野三山劝请熊野权现至芝之海滨；平安时代长久元年（1039 年），源氏名将源赖信将神社迁奉于此，正式成为旧饭仓村一带的氏神与总镇守。
太田道灌与港七福神：室町时代修筑江户城的传奇名将太田道灌对该社崇奉备至，神社境内特别设立了太田道灌劝请的“惠比寿太田稻荷社”，该社亦位列著名的“港七福神”之惠比寿神奉祀地；日本近代文豪岛崎藤村晚年曾定居于神社旁的饭仓台，在文学随笔中亦曾深情记录过这片古老街区的风物。
引路八咫乌与熊野牛王符：熊野神社的象征是三足神鸟「八咫乌（やたがらす）」，典出《日本神话》神武东征时为神武天皇开山引路的太阳神使，象征着在迷茫中“指引正确前路与开启命运”。神社传承的“熊野牛王神符”与八咫乌朱印，寓意着破除灾厄与指引良机。
古老创建故事按传统与传说阅读，不把它们当作已逐年核实的年表。
body.en: The note recounts a traditional foundation in the Yoro era, 717–724, through Gyoki's invitation of Kumano Gongen, and relocation by Minamoto no Yorinobu in 1039. It links the shrine with Ota Dokan, an Ebisu subsidiary shrine in the Minato Seven Lucky Gods, and writer Toson Shimazaki's later neighbourhood life. The yatagarasu is the three-legged guiding bird of Japanese tradition and the Kumano Go-o talisman. These early accounts remain tradition and legend, not a verified year-by-year chronology.

title.en: A dark giant, then bread around the corner

subtitle.zh: 灵友会释迦殿 → Comme'N TOKYO

paragraphs.zh: 沿着熟悉的路坡向上走，转角处冷不丁撞见一座通体漆黑、体量巨大的异形建筑——灵友会释迦殿。那座如巨型黑色外星母舰般突兀降落在繁华麻布台的野兽派金字塔，在周遭摩登流线的麻布台 Hills 映衬下，散发着宛如科幻电影般的荒诞与震撼。而随后在 Comme'N 咬下的两款新出炉手工面包，又把思绪温柔地拉回最质朴的麦香与人间烟火。
paragraphs.en: We continued uphill along familiar streets and suddenly encountered an enormous, entirely black, oddly shaped building: Reiyukai Shakaden. Like a giant alien mothership dropped into busy Azabudai, its brutalist pyramid form seemed surreal and startling beside Azabudai Hills' smooth modern lines. Then two freshly baked Comme'N breads gently returned our thoughts to simple wheat fragrance and everyday life.

paragraphs.zh: 沿着熟悉的麻布台山道向上前行，途中经过了一座体量庞大、造型极具未来科技感与视觉震撼力的奇异黑色建筑——「灵友会 釈迦殿 (Reiyukai Shakaden)」（语音转文字曾误记为“林友会”）。
paragraphs.en: Along the familiar Azabudai slope we passed the enormous, futuristic dark form of Reiyukai Shakaden, correcting the source's voice-transcribed name.

paragraphs.zh: 坐落于麻布台1丁目、毗邻麻布台之丘的「灵友会释迦殿」竣工于 1975 年，由日本著名建筑商竹中工务店（岩崎坚一主导）操刀设计。
paragraphs.en: The source dates the nearby Shakaden's completion to 1975 and credits Takenaka and Kenichi Iwasaki.

paragraphs.zh: 建筑通体覆盖着深黑色的花岗岩、不锈钢与巨大倾斜斜面，整体结构犹如一艘迫降在东京都心寸土寸金之地的“巨型黑色外星母舰”或“科幻金字塔”。极其强烈的野兽派/未来主义风格，与周围麻布台 Hills 的流线玻璃森林和东京塔交相辉映，给人一种穿梭于赛博朋克与神秘宗教圣殿之间的超现实视觉冲击。
paragraphs.en: Dark granite, stainless steel and huge sloping planes made it feel like an alien mothership or science-fiction pyramid beside Azabudai's flowing glass buildings and Tokyo Tower.

paragraphs.zh: 11:00 抵达麻布台 Hills，二刷前天深得我们赞誉的世界面包大赛总冠军名店——「Comme'N TOKYO（麻布台 Hills 店）」，挑选了两款全新出炉的手工风味面包当做早午餐，11:07 结账，酥脆香浓，大快朵颐。
paragraphs.en: 11:00: back at Azabudai, we returned to Comme'N for two fresh breads as brunch, settling the bill at 11:07.

title.zh: 走进无界，花与水漫过来
title.en: Entering Borderless, into flowers and flowing light

subtitle.zh: teamLab Borderless · 麻布台Hills

paragraphs.zh: 十一点半一头扎进 teamLab Borderless，那是一场长达两个半小时的彻底沉浸。
paragraphs.en: At half past eleven we entered teamLab Borderless for two and a half hours of complete immersion.

paragraphs.zh: 11:30 踏入位于麻布台 Hills Garden Plaza 的全球顶级数字艺术殿堂——「teamLab Borderless (森大厦数字艺术美术馆：无界)」。双人门票为行前在线信用卡购买。
paragraphs.en: 11:30: we entered Borderless in Azabudai Hills Garden Plaza, with tickets bought online before the trip.

paragraphs.zh: 没有固定的展线，没有物理的墙界，水流在脚下漫卷，光之飞鸟穿透身体在四壁飞翔。
paragraphs.en: There was no fixed route and no firm physical boundary; water spread beneath our feet and birds of light flew through us and across the walls.

caption.zh: 10.04 11:34 · 无界花朵与光影中的留影
caption.en: 10.04 11:34 · Portraits among Borderless flowers and light

caption.zh: 10.04 11:35 · 无界花朵与光影中的留影
caption.en: 10.04 11:35 · Portraits among Borderless flowers and light

paragraphs.zh: 梦幻沉浸体验：整个展馆彻底打破了传统展厅的物理界限，光影与自然元素在群室间自由流淌、互相交织与映射。人在如梦如幻的光影森林、漫天坠落的光之瀑布与浮游的水晶幻境中自由穿梭漫步，展品会随着人的脚步与触摸产生奇妙的实时互动，沉浸感与生命律动无与伦比，我们惊叹连连，整整沉浸畅玩到了 14:00！
paragraphs.en: Light and natural elements moved freely between rooms, interacting with our steps and touch. We wandered through projected flowers, falling light and mirrored spaces, staying until 14:00.

title.en: ENTRY NOTE

body.zh: 本次在线预订后入馆。官网按日期与时段售票，价格动态变化；无固定展线并不意味着无入场时段。https://www.teamlab.art/e/tokyo/
body.en: We booked online before entering. Official tickets specify date and time and use dynamic pricing; having no fixed route does not mean having no entry time. https://www.teamlab.art/e/tokyo/

title.zh: 把涂鸦带进海洋，带回家
title.en: Drawings into the sea, then home

subtitle.zh: 互动绘画 / Sketch Factory

paragraphs.zh: 我们像两个孩子一样在光影的迷宫里四处穿梭，甚至将自己涂鸦的一笔一画，在出口处的工坊里印成了可以带走的冰箱贴与拼图。
paragraphs.en: We wandered its maze like children, even turning our own drawings into a magnet and puzzle at the exit workshop.

caption.zh: 10.04 12:40 · 亲手绘制的海洋生物原稿
10.04 12:40 · 亲手绘制的海洋生物原稿

paragraphs.zh: Sketch Factory 定制专属纪念品：出馆后来到专属的「teamLab Sketch Factory」，我们将自己在展馆互动海洋中亲手涂鸦创作的海洋生物画稿，现场定制转化为了极具纪念意义的专属衍生品——金属冰箱贴与精致拼图，把独一无二的无界记忆随身带回家。
paragraphs.en: Sketch Factory turned the sea creatures we had drawn in the interactive ocean into a metal magnet and puzzle, letting us take our own Borderless memory home.

caption.en: 10.04 12:42 · Our drawings in the interactive ocean
10.04 12:47 · Our drawings in the interactive ocean

paragraphs.zh: teamLab Sketch Factory 现场定制出炉：14:04 在展馆专属工坊结账，成功将我们亲手涂鸦的海洋生物制作成极具纪念意义的专属周边——104片定制拼图（パズル104ピース）与定制磁吸冰箱贴（マグネット）。
paragraphs.en: At 14:04 the workshop purchase was completed: our own drawing made into a 104-piece puzzle and a magnetic souvenir.

title.en: One more room of changing light

subtitle.zh: teamLab红金色镜面 / 球形灯光

title.zh: 同一场参观的不同瞬间
title.en: MOMENTS WITHIN THE SAME VISIT

body.zh: 原笔记的11:30—14:00是一场连续参观；照片保留各自拍摄时间。绘画约12:40完成，出馆后14:04才将画稿定制为纪念品，不把工坊付款时间当作画画时间。
body.en: The note's 11:30–14:00 describes one continuous visit; images keep their own capture times. Drawing was around 12:40, while the custom souvenir purchase was at 14:04 after leaving. The workshop payment is not used as the drawing time.

title.zh: 把家人的心意装满提袋
title.en: Filling the bags with thoughts of family

subtitle.zh: Criollo / 中村藤吉

paragraphs.zh: 等候的间隙，中村藤吉的清苦抹茶香与 Criollo 丝滑的巧克力，把想要带给家人的心意装得满满当当。
paragraphs.en: While waiting, Nakamura Tokichi's subtly bitter matcha and Criollo's smooth chocolate filled our bags with things we wanted to bring to family.

title.en: 14:16 · SWEETS TO TAKE HOME

body.zh: Criollo选购Discovery精选圆盒礼盒、抹茶夹心小点、原味巧克力点心与纸袋。店铺、单品与付款明细保留在最后账本。
body.en: At Criollo we chose a Discovery round gift box, a matcha-filled sweet, a plain chocolate sweet and a paper bag. Store, products and payment details are retained in the final ledger.

paragraphs.zh: 中村藤吉宇治抹茶现饮与伴手礼：随后前往京都百年老字号「中村藤吉（麻布台店）」，14:28 点了一大杯冰镇薄茶牛奶（抹茶［薄茶］とミルク Cold L杯，贴心选了少冰少糖）与一份抹茶烘焙蛋糕（マルトベイク［抹茶］）边走边喝垫饥解渴；紧接着于 14:29 选购了送给家人的精装宇治抹茶伴手礼盒。
paragraphs.en: 14:28: at Nakamura Tokichi we chose a large cold thin-matcha milk with less ice and sugar and a Maruto Bake matcha cake; at 14:29 we selected a separate Uji matcha gift box for family.

caption.en: 10.04 14:34 · Thin-matcha milk with less ice and sugar

paragraphs.zh: 14:40 一切满载妥当，我们提着大包小包精美礼袋告别麻布台之丘，搭乘地铁前往下一站。
paragraphs.en: 14:40: with our gift bags filled, we left Azabudai Hills for the next stop.

title.en: Koami Shrine, without joining the queue

subtitle.zh: 人形町 / 小网神社

paragraphs.zh: 下午三点半的人形町，小网神社门前弯曲如长龙的浩荡人流，给了我们一点小小的震撼。看着那动辄数小时的队伍，想起它“都内最强强运与钱洗”的盛名，我们相视一眼，心底忽然释然——旅行的机缘贵在随遇而安，若是为了强求一份特别的灵验而将大好时光耗在焦灼的排队里，未免违背了初衷。在鸟居外合影打卡，坦然转身离去，倒成了另一种通透。
paragraphs.en: At half past three in Ningyocho, the winding crowds outside Koami Shrine gave us a little shock. Facing a queue that looked as though it could take hours, and thinking of its reputation for strong luck and money-washing, we exchanged a glance and let go. Travel's connections are best found naturally. Spending a lovely afternoon anxiously waiting for a particular blessing seemed contrary to why we had come. We photographed the torii from outside and turned away without regret: another sort of clarity.

paragraphs.zh: 下午从神谷町站刷 Suica 搭乘日比谷线直达人形町站，探访闻名遐迩的「小网神社（小網神社）」（语音曾转录为“小刚/小张神社”）。
paragraphs.en: We took the Hibiya Line from Kamiyacho to Ningyocho for Koami Shrine, correcting the source's voice-transcribed name.

paragraphs.zh: 约 15:30 抵达神社门口，狭窄的小巷中早已被排队参拜的信众里三层外三层围得水泄不通，人龙蜿蜒曲折、望不到头。
paragraphs.en: Around 15:30, the narrow lane was completely filled with worshippers waiting in a long, winding queue.

paragraphs.zh: 小网神社虽隐匿于市井街角，却是东京都内名气最大的“都内最强强运厄除”与“东京钱洗弁天（祈求财运）”圣地。然而看着这动辄数小时的漫长长龙，加之我们心中暗暗觉得“特地为了强烈特定目的去求偏财改运感觉不太符合随性旅行的心境”，一番权衡后，决定不再强行排队执着于参拜，而在神社鸟居外围拍照打卡留念。
paragraphs.en: The shrine's reputation for strong luck and money-washing did not change our decision: waiting for a particular blessing did not fit our spontaneous travelling mood. We photographed outside the torii instead.

title.en: A sunny portrait and a digital sea

subtitle.zh: 有乐町 / BIC CAMERA

paragraphs.zh: 有乐町的街头迎来了此行最明澈的湛蓝晴空。微凉秋风里，拉着宝子拍下一张毫无阴霾的灿烂合影，随后一头扎进了 BIC CAMERA 的数字海洋。拿下心仪已久的 Apple Watch Ultra，小土在电饭锅前纠结再三终究放弃，却在走出商场的那一刻，陷入了“萨洛蒙还是巴黎世家”的终极纠结。
paragraphs.en: Yurakucho's streets gave us the clearest blue sky of the trip. In the cool autumn breeze I pulled Xiaotu close for a bright, unclouded photograph, before we plunged into BicCamera's digital world. I bought the Apple Watch Ultra I had long wanted. Xiaotu pondered a rice cooker and eventually gave it up, only to walk outside and become torn between Salomon and Balenciaga shoes.

paragraphs.zh: 从人形町搭乘日比谷线直达日比谷站，出站漫步至有乐町。街道上秋阳高照、万里无云，我和宝子并肩定格了一张甜蜜灿烂的合影。
paragraphs.en: The Hibiya Line brought us from Ningyocho to Hibiya; we walked to Yurakucho and photographed ourselves beneath an entirely clear autumn sky.

paragraphs.zh: 16:17 旗舰智能手表拔草：我心心念念已久的顶级专业智能手表——Apple Watch Ultra，专柜直接免税，圆满拔草！
paragraphs.en: 16:17: I finally bought the Apple Watch Ultra I had wanted, with tax exemption at the counter.

paragraphs.zh: 17:22 个护数码与日用好物大扫荡：第二笔采购清单极度丰富，涵盖飞利浦便携电动鼻毛修剪器（NT3650/16）、松下电动剃须刀专用清洗液耗材整整 4 大盒（ES4L03）、小林制药加湿润喉口罩、Torriden 玻尿酸补水面膜 2 盒、3D 立体保湿面膜 2 盒、GUM 齿间刷以及日本网红零食 Jagabee 薯条等 13 件商品，全部免税并叠加优惠券。
paragraphs.en: 17:22: thirteen more items included a Philips NT3650/16 trimmer, four boxes of Panasonic ES4L03 cleaning fluid, throat-moistening masks, two Torriden and two 3D face-mask boxes, GUM interdental brushes and Jagabee snacks, using tax exemption and coupons.

paragraphs.zh: 小土在电饭锅专柜反复端详，因体积巨大难以携带而理智放弃。
paragraphs.en: Xiaotu studied the rice cooker display but sensibly gave up because it was too bulky to carry.

title.zh: 转乘更少，还是步行更少？
title.en: Fewer transfers, or less walking?

subtitle.zh: 东京站 → 新宿伊势丹

paragraphs.zh: 从有乐町奔向新宿的电车上，手忙脚乱差点错上一列提前发配成田的特快，随后又恍然大悟解开了数日以来的导航悬案——一个选了“转乘更少”，一个选了“步行更少”，两个南辙北辕的设置在手机上碰撞，逗得我们在车厢里啼笑皆非。在新宿伊势丹利落刷下巴黎世家的老爹鞋，又在 Brooks Brothers 为父亲挑好体面的秋装，六点半的退税与七点半伊势丹本馆那份松软绵密的清蒸蒲烧鳗鱼饭，将所有的疲惫揉进了一口温热的酱香里。
paragraphs.en: On the journey from Yurakucho to Shinjuku we almost hurried onto an express that would have sent us prematurely to Narita. Then the navigation mystery of the past few days finally clicked: one phone was set to fewer transfers, the other to less walking. Those opposing preferences colliding on our screens made us laugh helplessly. At Isetan we bought the Balenciaga chunky shoes and chose smart autumn clothes for Father at Brooks Brothers. The half-past-six refund stop and the soft, steamed-and-grilled eel rice at half past seven folded all our tiredness into a warm mouthful of sauce.

paragraphs.zh: 17:30 从 BIC CAMERA 走出来，小土陷入了今日最折磨人但也最有趣的“世纪大纠结”：究竟是拿下专业机能的萨洛蒙（Salomon）越野跑鞋，还是入手种草已久的巴黎世家（Balenciaga）经典“老爹鞋”？
paragraphs.en: 17:30: outside BicCamera, Xiaotu debated Salomon trail shoes against the Balenciaga chunky shoes he had been wanting.

paragraphs.zh: 在街头反复权衡纠结了半晌，小土最终一咬牙拍板：“买巴黎世家！”
paragraphs.en: After prolonged indecision he finally declared: 'Buy Balenciaga!'

paragraphs.zh: 于是我们做出了一个大胆的决定——离开银座/丸之内商圈，杀回第一天逛过的新宿伊势丹专柜！我们步行至东京站，刷 Suica 搭乘 JR 中央线快速直达新宿站（Shinjuku）。
paragraphs.en: We left the Ginza/Marunouchi area, walked to Tokyo Station and took the JR Chuo rapid back to Shinjuku.

paragraphs.zh: 这一趟转场险象环生：在错综复杂的地下铁道换乘中，我们险些误上了一列直奔成田机场方向的快速电车，差点提前被“发配成田”！好在眼疾手快及时核对撤回，虚惊一场。
paragraphs.en: In the confusing connections we almost boarded a train toward Narita, then caught the mistake in time.

caption.zh: 10.04 17:38 · 东京站夜色 / 新宿夜街
10.04 18:24 · 东京站夜色 / 新宿夜街

paragraphs.zh: 更搞笑的是，在这段奔波中我们终于破解了一个困扰数日的巨大谜团：原来我们两人手机地图的路线规划设置截然不同——我设置的是「转乘更少（乗換が少ない）」，宁可多走路也要少倒车；而小土设置的则是「步行更少（徒歩が少ない）」，宁可多倒几次车也一步不想多走！难怪几天来每次查路线我们屏幕上的推荐路线都不一样。我们相视大笑，纷纷感慨：“下次再来日本，必须全员焊死在‘步行更少’模式上，因为暴走几天腿实在要废了！”
paragraphs.en: We finally solved the different-map mystery: I preferred fewer changes, even with more walking; Xiaotu preferred less walking, even with more changes. We laughed and agreed that next time everyone should choose less walking—our legs could scarcely take any more.

paragraphs.zh: 18:30 顺利抵埗伊势丹新宿店男士馆（メンズ館），重返第一天就锁定的 Balenciaga 专柜：
paragraphs.en: 18:30: back at the Isetan men's building and the Balenciaga counter we had first noticed.

paragraphs.zh: 18:52 小土心仪的巴黎世家经典老爹鞋，出示三越伊势丹贵宾卡（GUEST CARD）立享 95 折优惠，微信支付，圆满拔草！
paragraphs.en: 18:52: Xiaotu's chunky shoes were purchased with the Isetan guest-card discount.

paragraphs.zh: 随后乘扶梯直奔 7 楼的美国名流老牌男装「Brooks Brothers（布克兄弟）」，十分孝顺地为小土爸爸挑选了两件有型体面的秋季衣物：
paragraphs.en: Then up to Brooks Brothers on floor seven for two autumn pieces for Xiaotu's father.

paragraphs.zh: 19:21 商务长袖衬衫 + 经典长袖 Polo 衫，贵宾卡 95 折优惠，微信支付。
paragraphs.en: 19:21: a dress shirt and long-sleeved polo with the guest-card discount.

paragraphs.zh: 19:29 前往伊势丹 6 楼 Global Blue 免税柜台办理合并退税，现场直接领回现金冲抵消费。
paragraphs.en: 19:29: combined Global Blue refund on floor six, collected in cash.

title.en: Eel rice and extreme packing

subtitle.zh: 伊势丹本馆7F → 滨松町

paragraphs.zh: 办完退税本打算去吃寿喜烧，但一看时间已过 19:30，寿喜烧等位耗时太久，为了不耽误今夜转场成田，我们当机立断改在伊势丹本馆 7 楼的美食餐饮街解决晚饭。
paragraphs.en: After the refunds we had intended sukiyaki, but it was after 19:30 and the wait threatened our Narita transfer. We chose the main building's seventh-floor restaurant area instead.

paragraphs.zh: 选定老牌江户前鳗鱼料理专门店「つきじ宮川本廛 伊勢丹新宿店」（筑地宫川本廛）入座享用鳗鱼饭定食：
paragraphs.en: At Tsukiji Miyagawa Honten we sat down for eel-rice sets.

paragraphs.zh: 20:06 开单，我们各点了一份主厨推荐鳗鱼饭套餐（オススメ）。
paragraphs.en: 20:06: two chef-recommended sets were ordered.

paragraphs.zh: 餐品承袭关东传统古法“先烤、后蒸、再浸酱复烤”，鳗鱼肉质极其松软绵密、入口即化，酱香温润优雅，与关西炭火烤制焦香酥脆的口感截然不同；
paragraphs.en: The source describes the Kanto preparation as grill, steam and sauce-grill again. The eel was extremely soft and tender, with gentle sauce, different from the crisp charcoal-grilled Kansai style.

paragraphs.zh: 20:07 微信支付，我们吃得十分满足，打出 4 星好评！
paragraphs.en: 20:07: bill settled, satisfied and giving four stars.

caption.zh: 10.04 19:53 · 宫川本廛完整鳗鱼套餐
caption.en: 10.04 19:53 · The complete eel set at Miyagawa Honten

paragraphs.zh: 晚上八点五十分冲回滨松町，狭窄的大堂里，两个行李箱被衣物、跑鞋、老爹鞋与伴手礼塞得几乎要炸开。合上箱扣的那一记闷响，宣告着东京漫游的彻底落幕。
paragraphs.en: At ten to nine we rushed back to Hamamatsucho. In the narrow lobby, clothes, running shoes, chunky shoes and gifts stuffed both suitcases almost to bursting. The dull click of their closing fasteners announced that our Tokyo wandering really was over.

paragraphs.zh: 20:20 饱餐结账，我们立即赶往新宿三丁目站，刷 Suica 搭乘都营大江户线返回大门站（Daimon），20:50 顺利折返回到滨松町 BAY HOTEL。
paragraphs.en: 20:20: from Shinjuku-sanchome we took the Oedo Line to Daimon, returning to BAY HOTEL around 20:50.

paragraphs.zh: 在大堂迅速取回白天的寄存行李，蹲在地上争分夺秒地展开“极限收纳”，将这几天在新宿、银座扫荡的所有衣物、跑鞋、老爹鞋、Apple Watch、护手霜与大包小包伴手礼全部严丝合缝地塞进行李箱，拉链拉上的一瞬间成就感爆棚！
paragraphs.en: We collected the stored bags and squatted on the lobby floor for extreme packing. Clothes, trainers, chunky shoes, Apple Watch, hand creams and gifts all had to fit. Closing the zip felt immensely satisfying.

title.en: Mountains and seas have a time to return

subtitle.zh: 大门 → 成田机场 → 东横INN

paragraphs.zh: 夜行列车向着成田的苍茫夜色飞驰。车窗外，属于东京都心的流光溢彩在身后渐渐隐去，而那些在箱根山雨里的奔跑、在新宿街头的扫荡、在多摩川仰望过的璀璨烟火，以及此刻身边疲惫却满足的温度，都已化作这趟旅途最丰满的印记。今夜宿在机场旁的东横 INN，明晨登机，山海有归期。
paragraphs.en: The night train sped into Narita's wide darkness. Tokyo's bright city lights slowly vanished behind the window, while running through Hakone rain, shopping in Shinjuku, looking up at Tamagawa fireworks and the tired but contented warmth beside me had all become the richest marks of the journey. Tonight we would sleep beside the airport at Toyoko Inn; tomorrow morning, a flight. Mountains and seas, too, have their time to return home.

paragraphs.zh: 拖着沉甸甸的箱子来到大门站，刷 Suica 搭乘都营浅草线直通京成电铁的成田机场特快（Access 特急），一路呼啸飞驰直达成田机场第 2·3 航站楼站（Narita Airport Terminal 2·3）。
paragraphs.en: Heavy bags in hand, we took the Asakusa Line through to the Keisei Access Express for Narita Airport Terminal 2·3.

paragraphs.zh: 顺利抵达成田机场，入住航站楼旁的「东横INN 成田机场本馆 (Toyoko Inn Narita Airport Honkan)」，在温馨平稳的客房中卸下所有负重。
paragraphs.en: We reached Narita and checked into Toyoko Inn Narita Airport Honkan, finally putting down the day's weight.

caption.zh: 10.04 23:20 · 东横INN成田机场本馆客房
caption.en: 10.04 23:20 · Toyoko Inn Narita Airport Honkan room

paragraphs.zh: 奔波大半夜饥肠辘辘，我们下楼来到酒店 1 楼罗森便利店狂扫夜宵与补给（分两笔微信支付结账）：
paragraphs.en: After a long night of travelling we went to the hotel's ground-floor Lawson for supper and supplies.

paragraphs.zh: 回到房间泡上热腾腾的辛拉面，大嚼着烤鸡肉串与大香肠，大口喝着冰牛奶，彻底卸下一整天的奔波与疲劳，洗漱躺平，准备迎接明日清晨全日空早班机的归途。
paragraphs.en: Back in the room we made hot Shin Ramyun, ate chicken skewers and sausage and drank cold milk. The day's fatigue could finally drain away; washed and lying down, we were ready for tomorrow's early ANA flight.

caption.en: 10.05 00:03 · Supper on the final night in Narita

title.zh: 10月5日｜归途终章：晨光、成田免税店与降落浦东
title.en: Homeward finale: morning light, Narita duty-free and Pudong

subtitle.zh: 东横INN → 成田T1

paragraphs.zh: 旅途的最后一个清晨，往往在一种既留恋又急切的奇妙张力中醒来。
paragraphs.en: The journey's final morning often begins with a curious tension between reluctance to leave and eagerness to get going.

paragraphs.zh: 昨夜在东横 INN 的客房里把箱子重新排列组合折腾到深夜，可当清晨五点半的闹钟响起，身体却像装了弹簧一样迅速清醒——只因心里还惦念着能在机场留出一段从容扫尾的时光。六点多下楼，在简单的免费餐台前盛上一小碗热气腾腾的咖喱饭，喝下一杯温热的玉米浓汤与黑咖啡，属于赶路人的晨光质朴而踏实。
paragraphs.en: We had rearranged the suitcases in our Toyoko Inn room until late, but the half-past-five alarm made us spring awake. We were still thinking of leaving ourselves time for one last relaxed airport shopping stop. After six, we spooned up a little hot curry rice at the simple free breakfast counter and drank warm corn soup and black coffee. A traveller's morning can be plain and reassuring.

paragraphs.zh: 昨夜在东横 INN 整理行李至深夜才睡，为了能提前抵达成田机场从容逛免税店，我们清晨 05:30 闹钟响起便利落起床，小土先洗漱，我紧随其后。
paragraphs.en: 05:30: after a late night packing, the alarm brought us straight up; Xiaotu washed first, then I followed.

paragraphs.zh: 快速收拾好随身行李退房，06:15 左右下楼来到大堂享用酒店提供的免费日式早餐。
paragraphs.en: Around 06:15: downstairs for the hotel's free breakfast after packing and checkout.

paragraphs.zh: 早餐虽为免费但供应颇具诚意：温热暖胃的香浓玉米浓汤、经典日式咖喱饭，以及小烘焙面包配热咖啡。我们各吃了少许垫饥提神，整装待发。
paragraphs.en: Corn soup, Japanese curry rice, little breads and hot coffee made a modest but generous breakfast.

paragraphs.zh: 清晨六点半的班车穿过成田微凉的晨霭，不到二十分钟便滑停在 T1 出发层。原以为九点二十分的航班留两小时会手忙脚乱，未曾想日本公共交通与机场的运转效率再次惊艳了我们：自助取票、自助托运行李不到五分钟搞定，安检通道十五分钟丝滑通关。当七点二十分施施然踱进免税区的那一刻，那种“平白多偷来一小时”的意外之喜，让整个人瞬间舒展开来。
paragraphs.en: The half-past-six shuttle crossed Narita's cool morning haze and stopped at the T1 departures level in under twenty minutes. We had feared that two hours before a nine-twenty flight would mean a scramble; instead the efficiency of transport and airport services impressed us again. Self check-in and bag drop took under five minutes, and security passed in fifteen. Walking into duty-free at seven-twenty felt like finding an extra hour, and our whole bodies relaxed.

paragraphs.zh: 06:30 准时坐上东横 INN 开往成田机场的免费穿梭巴士，清晨公路通畅平稳。
paragraphs.en: 06:30: the free hotel bus left for Narita Airport along quiet morning roads.

paragraphs.zh: 耗时不到 20 分钟，约 06:50 顺利抵达成田机场第 1 航站楼（T1）出发层。
paragraphs.en: In under twenty minutes, about 06:50, we reached T1's departures level.

paragraphs.zh: 出发大厅秩序井然，07:00 机场工作人员陆续上岗。
paragraphs.en: 07:00: staff began work in the orderly departure hall.

paragraphs.zh: 自助行李托运系统操作顺畅，不到 5 分钟便搞定两件沉重的大行李箱；
paragraphs.en: The self-service bag drop took under five minutes for both heavy cases.

paragraphs.zh: 随后安全检查与通关仅耗时约 15~20 分钟。
paragraphs.en: Security and departure formalities took about fifteen to twenty minutes.

paragraphs.zh: 07:20 我们便顺利通关进入机场免税商业区，比预期多出了整整一个多小时的充裕逛街时间。
paragraphs.en: 07:20: already inside duty-free, with over an extra hour compared with our expectations.

title.zh: 最后的伴手礼，降落浦东
title.en: Last gifts, then landing at Pudong

subtitle.zh: ANA免税店 / Fa-So-La → NH919

paragraphs.zh: 在 ANA 免税店与 Fa-So-La 的货架前，我们把离京前最后的挂念变成了沉甸甸的提袋：给妈妈们挑的怡丽丝尔紧致面霜、给长辈备齐的 The Peace 与梅比乌斯香烟，还有在酒柜前精心抱回的獭祭二割三分、满寿泉 Link 8888 与八海山纯米大吟酿；货架上散发着质朴香气的国产味噌、文明堂松软甜润的铜锣烧与东京香蕉蛋糕，则是带给日常餐桌的最贴心念想。
paragraphs.en: At the ANA Duty Free and Fa-So-La shelves, our last thoughts before leaving became heavy shopping bags: Elixir firming creams for our mothers, The Peace and Mevius cigarettes for older family, and carefully chosen Dassai 23, Masuizumi Link 8888 and Hakkaisan junmai daiginjo. Plain, fragrant Japanese miso, soft Bunmeido dorayaki and Tokyo Banana cakes were gentler reminders to bring to the everyday table.

paragraphs.zh: 选购长辈心仪的日式名烟：梅比乌斯（MEVIUS E-Series 1 100 S）、日本顶级名烟 The Peace 铁盒香烟 2 条、卡崩黑标细支雪茄型香烟（Cigaronne Royal Slims Black）；
paragraphs.en: For older family: Mevius E-Series 1 100 S, two cartons of The Peace and Cigaronne Royal Slims Black.

paragraphs.zh: 选购孝敬妈妈们的高端抗老护肤好物：资生堂怡丽丝尔 V 脸紧致塑颜面霜 2 罐（Elixir Total V Firming Cream）与怡丽丝尔净白紧致洁面乳；
paragraphs.en: For our mothers: two Elixir Total V Firming Cream jars and an Elixir cleanser.

paragraphs.zh: 扫荡日本国宝级名酒：獭祭 纯米大吟酿 磨之二割三分、满寿泉 Link 8888 芝华士威士忌橡木桶熟成纯米大吟酿 750ml 以及八海山 纯米大吟酿 720ml；
paragraphs.en: From the sake shelves: Dassai 23, a 750ml Masuizumi Link 8888 matured in a Chivas whisky cask, and 720ml Hakkaisan junmai daiginjo.

paragraphs.zh: 08:41 在特色食品免税店添置纯正日本风味：日本国产纯正味噌 500g、京都老字号文明堂铜锣烧 8 个入（文明堂しっとりどら焼き）、北海道 Calbee 薯条三兄弟 10 袋入（じゃがポックル）、以及东京标志性伴手礼东京香蕉蛋糕 8 入 2 盒（東京ばな奈）；
paragraphs.en: 08:41 at Fa-So-La: 500g Japanese miso, eight Bunmeido dorayaki, ten packs of Jaga Pokkuru and two eight-piece Tokyo Banana boxes.

paragraphs.zh: 八点半登机，九点二十分舷窗外的机翼划破成田的云层直冲蓝天。两个小时的飞行像是一场短暂的过渡，当机轮在上午十一点二十分重重触及浦东机场跑道的那一刻，东京的繁华与箱根的微雨彻底定格成了记忆里的胶片。
paragraphs.en: We boarded at half past eight; at nine-twenty the wing cut through Narita's clouds toward blue sky. The two-hour flight felt like a brief transition. When the wheels touched Pudong's runway at eleven-twenty, Tokyo's bustle and Hakone's fine rain were fixed as frames in memory.

paragraphs.zh: 08:30 登机口排队登机，09:20 搭乘全日空 NH919 航班自成田 T1 准时滑出起飞。
paragraphs.en: Around 08:30 the note records boarding preparation; NH919 departed from Narita T1 at 09:20.

paragraphs.zh: 航程平稳顺遂，在万米高空小憩，回味 7 天来的东京与箱根漫游。
paragraphs.en: The smooth flight let us rest and think back over our seven days.

paragraphs.zh: 11:20 航班准点降落上海浦东国际机场 T2。下机、提取大件行李并通关出境虽稍候了些时间，但满载着沉甸甸的战利品与美好回忆，我们平安踏出浦东机场，这场浪漫充实的国庆日本秋日漫游画上圆满句号！
paragraphs.en: 11:20: landed at Pudong T2. Bags and arrivals took a little longer, but we stepped safely out with heavy purchases and full memories.

paragraphs.zh: 出关的人流熙熙攘攘，拖着沉甸甸的箱子挪出航站楼虽然等了好一阵子，但看着手腕上新戴上的 Apple Watch、脚下舒服的老爹鞋，想起在箱根山道大雨里的跳车、多摩川边仰望过的漫天璀璨烟火，以及深夜居酒屋里冒着热气的烤串——七天六晚，有惊无险，满载而归。旅途虽有终点，但生活里那些滚烫而闪光的瞬间，才正要长久地发酵下去。
paragraphs.en: Arrivals was crowded, and it took a while to wheel our heavy cases out of the terminal. Yet looking at the new Apple Watch on my wrist and the comfortable chunky shoes at our feet brought back jumping off a bus in heavy Hakone rain, the brilliance above the Tamagawa and hot skewers in a late-night izakaya. Seven days and six nights: safely home, bags full. A journey ends, but life's warm, shining moments are only beginning to deepen and stay.

title.en: HOW THE SOURCE TIMES ARE KEPT

body.zh: 八篇中文随笔完整保留原文，长段落只在对应场景处分开，不改字句；行程记录仅将付款细节移到最后，保留事件、时间、菜品、型号和真实感受。08:30登机与08:41最后免税采购、箱根赴东京约两小时与到达时刻等原笔记差异，不强凑成分秒一致的流水账。相机时间只补画面对应，不推翻笔记。
body.en: All eight Chinese daily essays are preserved verbatim; one long paragraph is divided only at the relevant scenes, with no wording lost. Itinerary payment details are moved to the ledger, while events, times, dishes, models and reactions remain. The note's 08:30 boarding versus 08:41 last purchase, and approximate Tokyo-transfer duration versus arrival time, are not forced into minute-perfect agreement. Camera times supply photo context rather than overrule the note.

title.en: PHOTO NOTE

body.zh: 从素材里精选135张照片，去掉近似连拍、重复试衣角度和来源不明的晴天对照。票据、凭证与轨迹素材不进入页面。每张缩略图仍可打开完整原图；元数据已清除。私人页文字加密，但Azure照片仍可公开访问。
body.en: The entry selects 135 photographs, omitting near-repeat shots, repeated fitting angles and sunny comparisons of unconfirmed origin. Receipts, credentials and route-track images are not displayed. Each thumbnail still opens its complete original; metadata is stripped. Journal text is encrypted, but Azure photographs remain publicly accessible.
